name: Eemsmondloop
description: The Eemsmondloop is a half marathon held in Uithuizermeeden on Saturday, November 21, 2026. This running race is a challenging test in the north of the Netherlands and attracts many participants each year. The organizers offer the option to collect race numbers in advance and arrange train transport to the start in Eemshaven. The race is known for its scenic course and good organization.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance of 21.1 km
Start in Eemshaven, with train transport from Uithuizermeeden
Option to collect race numbers in advance
additional: Race numbers can be collected up to 45 minutes before the start. Trains depart from Uithuizermeeden to the start in Eemshaven at 09:30, 10:00, and 10:30. Parking is available at Uithuizermeeden train station. Registration opens on March 1, 2026; participants can use the train and transport options, and a results page is available.

name: Halve van Monster
price_range: vanaf €11,00 tot €16,00 plus €4,50 voor de chip

price_tiers.distance: Lopers Company Westland Walkingtours (10.3 km & 5.4 km)

description: The Halve van Monster is an annual running event held in November in Monster. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon (21.1 km), a 10.3 km run and a 5.4 km run. The course passes through the dunes and along the beach, with the start and finish at De Wielepet sports hall. Walking tours are also offered over the same routes in the opposite direction. Each year, the organizers support a charitable cause, giving the event extra meaning.
course_highlights: Course through the dunes
Run along the beach
Start and finish at De Wielepet sports hall
additional: Timing with a reusable SAW chip is mandatory. The chip costs €4.50 and can be returned after the event in exchange for a refreshment. Registration on the day is not possible; online registration is available until 11:00 on race day. The prize ceremony takes place at De Wielepet sports hall after the half marathon. Registration is online in advance only; donations to the charitable cause are possible. No registration on the day.

name: Zac Freudenburg Cross
description: The Zac Freudenburg Cross (ZFC) is an annual cross-country race organized by WegCie of the Groningen Student Athletics Association Vitalis. The race takes place at Hoornseplas in Groningen and honors American athlete Zac Freudenburg, known for his impressive performances in longer-distance events. The ZFC has a rich history and attracts runners who enjoy challenging cross-country courses in a natural setting. The event is organized by a dedicated student committee that ensures a well-organized and sporting day.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Hoornseplas
Natural and challenging terrain
Historic connection to athlete Zac Freudenburg
additional: Location: Hoornseplas, Groningen; organized by WegCie of GSAV Vitalis

name: Halve Marathon Uithuizermeeden
location: Eemshaven, Municipality of Het Hogeland, Groningen, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost € 17,50 per persoon. Dit is inclusief vervoer van Uithuizermeeden naar de Eemshaven.

description: The Halve Marathon Uithuizermeeden is a challenging 21.1 km run that starts in Eemshaven and finishes in Uithuizermeeden. The race has a time limit of 2.5 hours and provides participants with train transport from Uithuizermeeden to the start. The organizers ensure that clothing brought to the start is transported to the finish, making the run more comfortable. The event attracts many enthusiastic runners each year, who brave the elements in a welcoming and well-organized setting.
course_highlights: Starts in Eemshaven and finishes in Uithuizermeeden
21.1 km distance with a time limit of 2.5 hours
Train transport from Uithuizermeeden to the start
additional: Race numbers can be collected up to 45 minutes before the start. Parking is available at Uithuizermeeden train station. The organizers transport clothing from the start to the finish. Trains depart from Uithuizermeeden to the start at 09:30, 10:00 and 10:30. Train transport, including transport from Uithuizermeeden to Eemshaven; no return shuttle service; registration usually opens from March 2026; the race attracts hundreds of participants each year.

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road course
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For information about the race, contact Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697). Race information is also available by calling Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest terrain
Part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
additional: The race takes place on 21 April 2026 and is part of a series of local runs. The course is mostly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Čáp is a public hill running race with a mass start, held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running
additional: Tea and refreshments are provided for runners at the finish. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. The organizers are Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 12 km main category around Slaný
Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November; the most recent edition took place on 29 November 2025. The organizers thank all participants and look forward to the next edition. In the past, around 70 runners took part in the main category, along with several dozen children and young people. The main race is 12 km. Registration takes place at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný, and the races are held on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at 10:00.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 111 Kč

description: Čertovskej wintertrail is a trail race through the hills, forests and rocky terrain around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Trail running through hills, forests and rocky terrain
Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with cut-off times at the aid stations at km 15 (3 hours) and km 25 (5 hours). Runners must bring their own drinking cup; a Čertovskej running cup is available to buy at race registration. The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: Vranov Trail
location: Vranov, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Trail is a series of running races organized by friends who run ultratrails and create high-quality events with carefully planned courses, good food, and a relaxed atmosphere. The races take place around Brno and Vranov, often in forests and on trails with carefully marked routes. Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: Courses follow forest paths and trails around Brno and Vranov
Routes are clearly marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks
additional: Race facilities are often set up outdoors at the Stará Prádelna or Samovýčep venues. There are plenty of refreshments on the course, including water and sports drinks, and hot food after the finish. After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

name: XLVII MnO Pierwszy Śnieg
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Orienteeringu, GKT Cyrkino Gliwice, Czartak Katowice, AKInO Kraków, RO PTTK Częstochowa, PlesInO Pszczyna, be-lość Piekary Śląskie, Krokus Miliardowice
description: The Silesian Voivodeship Orienteering Walks Cup is a series of events organized by tourism clubs and groups across Silesia. Competitions take place in different rounds throughout the year, with participants competing in six age categories and a team classification. The “First Snow” round is the tenth edition of the cup in the 2026 season and will take place on November 21 in Katowice. The event combines sporting competition with spending active time outdoors and navigating the terrain.
course_highlights: Orienteering walks across the Silesian Voivodeship
Competition in six age categories
Team classification and cups for the top participants
additional: The event includes different age categories, is part of an orienteering event series, and takes place in forested and urban areas in Katowice.

Memmelsdorfer Schlosslauf
description: The Memmelsdorf Castle Run is a longstanding running event held annually in Memmelsdorf since 1985. The event offers various race distances around Seehof Palace, with community and the beautiful setting at its heart. Participants of all ages are warmly invited to explore the varied routes in and around the palace and enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Runs around Seehof Palace
Various distances for all age groups
Scenic routes through the palace park and surrounding forests
additional: Multiple race distances, including Bambini, junior races and a fun run; registration and detailed information on the website; the event takes place in late November.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: WMF BKK AST Süßen Herbstlauf
description: The WMF BKK AST Süßen Autumn Run is a long-established running event held annually in Süßen. It offers main races over 5 km and 11 km, a 1.8 km youth race, and a 5 km walking route. The event takes place at the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, which is open from 11:00 a.m. into the evening. The Autumn Run welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 11 km
1.8 km youth race
5 km walking route
additional: The venue is the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, open from 11:00 a.m. until the evening. Races are available for different age and ability groups, along with a walking route. The event is part of AST Süßen’s club life. Courses are not officially measured; on-site registration is available; bibs use transponder timing; various running and walking options are offered for all age groups.

name: Winterlaufserie TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen – 1. Lauf
description: Die Winterlaufserie des TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Weidelsburgstadion in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. Sie umfasst mehrere Läufe mit Distanzen von 310 m bis 15 km auf befestigten und geteerten Waldwegen. Die Serie richtet sich an alle Altersklassen und bietet eine Einzel- und Mannschaftswertung mit Urkunden und Auszeichnungen. Die Veranstaltung ist vom Hessischen Leichtathletik-Verband genehmigt und legt Wert auf faire Bedingungen, beispielsweise ist das Tragen von Spikes nicht erlaubt.

There are several race distances for youth and seniors, ranging from 5,100 metres to 9,400 metres. The cross is a challenging, competitive event where participants can earn points towards the circuit standings.
course_highlights: Race distances range from 5,100 metres (youth and recreational women) to 9,400 metres (men and recreational women or longer categories)
Part of the All4running cross circuit, with points counting towards the overall standings
Age categories are divided into five-year groups from age 19 onwards
additional: The circuit's final prizes are awarded in age groups for youth and adults. To qualify for the standings, participants must take part in at least four circuit races; their four best results count. Anyone who runs all five cross-country races receives 10 bonus points. Lost property is kept by the organising club for 14 days. The category entered in the first race applies throughout the circuit. Daily prizes are awarded based on the category on race day. The race is part of the All4running cross circuit, with events scheduled in October, November and December 2026. Registration is available on race day, and participants must run at least four races to qualify for the standings. Locations include Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk.

description: The Schalmloop Mariënheem is a popular winter cross-country race that has been part of Mariënheem’s sporting winter calendar since 1986. The race takes place around the Boetelerveld nature reserve, on a recently renewed course consisting of more than 80% unpaved paths and muddy sections. Since 2024, the start has been at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, improving accessibility and atmosphere. The Schalmloop offers distances for all ages and is known for its challenging, varied nature route with gentle elevation changes. The event promises a friendly, active winter day outdoors.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly through the Boetelerveld nature reserve
More than 80% unpaved sandy paths and muddy sections
A varied route with gentle elevation changes and plenty of nature
additional: The Schalmloop offers several distances: 1.3 km (start 11:45), 2.6 km (start 11:25), 5.2 km (start 12:00) and 10.7 km (start 10:00). The start is at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, Raamsweg 47A. More than 80% of the course is unpaved and it can be deceptively slippery depending on the weather. The short loops make the event appealing to spectators. Raamsweg from Raalte is closed during the event; approach via Kroepeweg. Distances: 1.3 km, 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 10.7 km; terrain: unpaved and muddy; date: 22 November 2026

description: The Westeinderloop is a running event organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer, held at Sportpark Calslagen in Kudelstaart. The race offers runners a great opportunity to take part in a competition in a friendly, sporty atmosphere. The route runs through the area around the Westeinderplassen, making for a varied and appealing course. The event is suitable for different ages and ability levels and contributes to the local sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Calslagen
Run through the area around the Westeinderplassen
A varied course with beautiful scenery
additional: Course along the Westeinder, several categories including youth and G-Run, parking at RKDES, accessible by public transport

name: Sperwers trailrun
description: The Sperwers trail run is a challenging trail race set in the beautiful landscape of Exloo, Drenthe. The race offers two distances, 7 km and 14 km, and takes participants along natural paths and through wooded areas. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Registration closes on 15 November 2026.
course_highlights: Trail run through wooded areas in Exloo
Natural paths and challenging terrain
Choice of 7 km and 14 km distances
additional: Trail terrain, registration closed, event on 22 November 2026, weather information available

name: Maarten Maartens Trailrun
description: The Maarten Maartens Trail Run is a welcoming trail race held on the beautiful Zonheuvel estate in Doorn, on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The 6, 10 and 20 km routes wind through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest and are mostly unpaved, with the entire course marked with arrows and ribbons. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants can read their time from the race clock. After the race, refreshments are available, and the winners are honoured at the historic Maarten Maartens House. The trail run is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike who enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Routes through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Mostly unpaved course, clearly marked with arrows and ribbons
Start and finish at the historic Maarten Maartens House on the Zonheuvel estate
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 12:30 until 15 minutes before the start. The 20 km race consists of 2 laps, with a refreshment station halfway. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants read their time from the race clock. Prizes are awarded to the first three women and men. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on the steps of the Maarten Maartens House. No electronic timekeeping; refreshments are available after the race and halfway for 20 km runners; prizes for the top three women and men; race numbers can be collected in advance.

name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The event is part of the Monaka race series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to take part and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: A traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

description: The 13th Maków Fifteen is an annual race held in Maków Mazowiecki, taking place on November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with the start and finish located at the municipal stadium. It is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club together with local authorities. The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners
additional: Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are displayed instantly on a television at the finish and sent to runners by SMS. The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewnickie forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Children and young people under 18 may participate only when accompanied by a parent or guardian. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable, but they may be transferred to the next start if the request is submitted by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the start. Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

name: Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberger Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in the festively decorated city center of Freiberg, combining sporting activity with the special atmosphere of the run-up to Christmas. The event is a regional highlight, with several races for different age groups and distances. It attracts many runners every year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, including the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz. Registration opens in June 2026 and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical accompaniment from the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay
additional: Race number pickup from 12:00 at Rüleinsporthalle; late entries and changes are possible until 1 hour before the start. All races start at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children's Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026; late entries are possible on race day. Start times: Bambini Run at 15:00, Children's Run at 15:15, Teen Run at 15:30, Fun Run at 15:45, Main Run at 16:30.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesum Advent Run is a long-established running event in Rheine, offering various distances from 1 to 10 kilometres. More than 660 runners took part in the 37th edition in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event attracts a broad range of participants, including many athletes from Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten, who achieved excellent results in various age groups. The race offers an appealing competition during Advent for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Races over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
More than 660 finishers
Top placings in various age groups
additional: The race takes place in cool temperatures and usually sunny weather. The event includes several distances suitable for young people and children. Laufgemeinschaft Emsdetten is strongly represented and supports the event. Races in Rheine-Mesum, family-friendly, flat courses, races for children and young people

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Reichenbach near Lahr/Black Forest is a DLV-sanctioned race eligible for rankings, with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The course follows a 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths, mostly flat with gentle climbs. The start and finish are beside the Schutter, near the Geroldseckerhalle. There is also a 5.5 km walking route through the forest and local districts, offering beautiful views of Hohengeroldseck Castle.
course_highlights: 2 x 5 km loop over paved and forest paths
Flat course profile with gentle, short climbs
Walking route with views of Hohengeroldseck Castle
additional: The 5.5 km walking event starts at 14:10 near the finish area. Based on experience, the start area for the 5 km and 10 km races is very cramped, so arriving early is recommended. The walking route passes historic and scenic points. Courses over paved and forest paths; start and finish beside the Geroldseckerhalle; limited parking; arriving early is recommended.

name: Villmarer Dorflauf
description: The Villmar Village Run is a long-standing race held in Villmar at the end of November. Races are offered over 5 km and 10 km, and young people may also take part in the adult races. The course is flat, and all events finish in the same area. Children’s and youth races are also held; further details are provided in the official race announcement. Now in its 33rd edition, the race is a fixture on the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat course
All adult races finish in the same area
Children’s and youth races in addition to the main programme
additional: The 5 km run and 5 km walk start first, followed by the 10 km run. Typical November weather in Villmar is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. The race takes place in November; exact details about registration and participation are available in the official race announcement.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: Der Volksbank WeinstadtCross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf, der am 29. November 2026 in Weinstadt stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung umfasst am Samstag Schulmeisterschaften, Kinder- und Jugendläufe sowie den JedermannCross, während am Sonntag die Deutschen Crossmeisterschaften ausgetragen werden. Die anspruchsvolle Strecke führt querfeldein über unebenes Gelände, durch Matsch und steile Anstiege und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Alters- und Leistungsklassen ein echtes Lauferlebnis. Der WeinstadtCross ist Teil des Deutschen Cross Cups und zieht Teilnehmer aus ganz Deutschland an.

location: Kulturhus de Spil, Lettele, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oostermaetloop in Lettele is a friendly running event held at Kulturhus de Spil. It offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The start times are spread throughout the afternoon, with a welcoming atmosphere and an announcer guiding the event. The event is organized by VV Lettele, and registration is easy via mijninschrijving.nl.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km
Start and finish at Kulturhus de Spil
Friendly local atmosphere with announcer Henk Borgmeijer
additional: Same-day registration is available between 11:30 and 13:30, depending on the distance. The 1 km run is free and starts at 12:30, the 2 km starts at 12:45, the 5 km at 13:15, and the 10 km at 14:10. The location is Kulturhus de Spil, Sportweg 1, 7434 RZ Lettele. Distances range from 1 km to 10 km, with start times between 12:30 and 14:10. The course is 90–95% unpaved. The atmosphere is festive, with pieten and marksmen.

name: Simply Move It
location: Hoge Bergse Bos, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands
organizer: Mees en Vincent van Simply Move It
description: Simply Move It is a challenging Backyard Ultra running event held in Hoge Bergse Bos near Rotterdam. Participants run a 6.7 km lap every hour, for up to 24 hours and a distance of 160 km. The unique format challenges runners to finish within the hour and start again, with the finish line being personal to each participant. The course consists of trail and singletrack paths with climbs, making it ideal for trail-running and ultrarunning enthusiasts. The event is popular and fills up quickly, with an active community and additional clinics to improve running technique.
course_highlights: Trail and mountain-bike course in Hoge Bergse Bos
6.7 km per lap, with singletrack and climbs
Unique Backyard Ultra format: one lap every hour, for up to 24 hours
additional: The 24-hour edition on 28 - 29 November 2026 is fully booked; you can sign up for the waiting list. There is a WhatsApp group for participant updates and practical information. A Trail Run Clinic will be held on 26 September in collaboration with Salomon and Runnersworld Rotterdam. The event offers solo and duo formats, with a base camp and crew facilities. Participants must follow the safety rules and code of conduct. The final route will be announced later. Trail and ultrarunning, maximum 24 hours, course with approximately 130 metres of elevation gain per lap, duo option available, close to Rotterdam

name: Walvoort Rondje Nederland
price_range: Vanaf €5,50 tot €13,00 afhankelijk van afstand en leeftijd
description: Walvoort Rondje Nederland Evening Run is a fun family run taking place on Saturday evening, 28 November 2026, at the Netherlands Open Air Museum in Arnhem. The event offers youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races to ensure equal opportunities. The atmosphere is enthusiastic and welcoming, with special attention to children and their accompanying adults. Timing is provided using the Ipico system, and ample parking and facilities are available for participants and supporters.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Netherlands Open Air Museum
Youth races split into boys’ and girls’ races
Evening run with a fun, family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Children up to and including 12 years old receive an extra wristband for an accompanying adult, which includes free admission. Other supporters pay €7.50 admission, which can be reserved via the registration form. Parking at the Open Air Museum is free. Changing space and luggage lockers are limited; there are no showers. First aid is available. Timing chips must be returned after the event, otherwise a €10 fee will be charged. Volunteers are welcome: info@rondjenederland.com. The course is at the Netherlands Open Air Museum. Registration is open until 12 noon on 28 November. Accompanying adults with a museum card receive free admission. Timing is provided using chips. The event supports childhood cancer research. There are no showers.

description: The Elderschanscross in Aardenburg is a challenging cross-country race held in a natural setting with varied terrain. The race is organized by Atletiekvereniging De Wielingen, which is known for its wide range of athletics activities. The cross-country race offers a lovely mix of nature and sport, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers provide a welcoming and sporty day for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with asphalt, dune paths and beach
Beautiful views of the ’t Zwin nature reserve and the West Zeeuws-Vlaanderen coast
Various elevation changes and challenging dune sections
additional: The Kerzantse Kilometer (KEKI) starts around 12:15 after the half marathon and 3 Zeemijl. KEKI entries are accepted only on the day of the event, in person at the sports hall. Parental consent is required when registering children aged 15 and under for photos to be published. Late registration for the half marathon is available on the day from 9:30 at the Cadzand-Bad sports hall. Payment can be made via iDeal, Bancontact, WERO or credit card. Entry fees are non-refundable after 1 January. The event has a long history and attracts runners of different levels. No specific information about registration or costs is available.

name: 57e AV Climax Horaloop
description: The 57th AV Climax Horaloop takes place on Saturday, 28 November 2026, in Ede. The race offers several distances, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles (16.1 km). The course runs through the hills of Hoekelumse Bos and the rolling valley of the Renkumse beek, with a choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails. The Horaloop is an atmospheric and challenging race, with chip timing and a welcoming finish venue at Hoekelum Castle.
course_highlights: Hilly course through Hoekelumse Bos
Rolling landscape along the Renkumse beek
Choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected on Friday, 27 November, between 18:00 and 21:00 at Atletiek Vereniging Climax, or on race day from 8:30 until 20 minutes before the start. There is a 2-hour time limit for the 10 English miles. Water stations are available along the route. There is no supervised cloakroom, but there is a place to leave belongings at your own risk. A changing tent is available; there are no showers. Parking is at Hoekelum farm, with clear directions and traffic marshals. Dogs are not allowed during the race. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the race offers options for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross
location: Atletiekterrein AV Rijssen, Rijssen, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Storekeeper Rijsserbergcross is an annual cross-country race, celebrating its 27th edition this year. The race takes place in beautiful, hilly surroundings around the AV Rijssen athletics grounds, where the start and finish are located. Several distances are offered, catering to different ability levels. The cross-country race is known for its challenging course and welcoming organization.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around the athletics grounds
Start and finish on the AV Rijssen athletics track
Various distances for different ability levels
additional: The race is part of a broader athletics program and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.

name: Nienoord crossloop Leek
description: The Nienoord Crossloop Leek takes place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, in Leek, Groningen. Participants can choose between distances of 5 and 10 kilometers. This cross-country race offers a challenging course in a natural setting, ideal for runners who enjoy a varied trail. For the most up-to-date information, please refer to the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Cross-country course in a natural setting
Held in Leek, Groningen
additional: The race takes place in a natural setting, registration is required, and the event offers a sporting challenge for runners of all levels.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Rhenen
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two loops of more than 50 km each, spread over two days, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose to run one of the 50+ km loops or the full 109 km over both days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two loops of 50+ km across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: Because of the short daylight hours, the UHUT100 Winter is spread over two days, with a 09:00 start on Saturday and Sunday. Participants navigate entirely by GPX and receive refreshments every 10–15 km. The finish is before 17:00 on both days. All ultra participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race number. The race takes place in November 2026, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose the 50 km distance or the full UHUT100, which covers more than 100 km. The race is characterised by winter conditions and a challenging course through the nature of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting along the Dřevnice River. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race, taking place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with extensive facilities and refreshments after the finish. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, timing, race photos, prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes, taking their health and abilities into account.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt
A forest trail with tree roots and several wooded hills
A road crossing supervised by a volunteer and a section along an MTB route
additional: The entry fee includes refreshments after the finish, including tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savory pastries, Christmas breads, bananas, and energy bars. Winners are announced and raffle prizes are drawn after the race. The race bib has a timing chip that must be returned after finishing (a 500 Kč fee applies if it is lost). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. Runners are advised to write any allergies and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration, including gift vouchers; proceeds support charity; a detailed route description is available.

name: Stupenská sedmička
location: TJ Sokol Stupno, Stupno, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč do neděle 25. 10. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 250 Kč do neděle 22. 11. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

description: Stupenská sedmička is a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly, with plenty of amenities, including refreshments, medals, timing, and a raffle. The course runs along forest trails, fields, and cycle paths, with several hills and road crossings monitored by volunteers.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several hills
Road crossings monitored by volunteers, with part of the route on a cycle path
additional: The entry fee includes post-race refreshments (tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savoury pastries, Christmas bread, bananas, and bars), a finisher’s medal, course marking, timing, race photos, prizes for the winners, and a raffle. Runners attend a briefing and course description before the start; the awards ceremony and raffle draw take place after the race. The race is also suitable for complete beginners and children. The sixth edition takes place on November 28, 2026. The first category starts at 10:00.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time among the city’s green spaces. The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation
additional: The event office is open from 9:00. To be included in the results, advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, making it a great way to end the month actively. trail run, online registration, start and finish in the clearing behind Piast Stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a demanding 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organised by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: The new course is available online
Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organiser: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can only be paid via an individual link to quick online payments through tpay.com, sent by email. After 31 October 2026, entry is possible only with the organiser’s consent and without the full race package. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Giessen, is a flat running event held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as races for children and young people. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available through RUNME Premium. The run takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Races for children and young people
additional: The start and finish are the same for all races. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published on the RUNME results page shortly after runners finish. The event is for adults, children, and young people, with start times in the morning. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium.

name: Adventslauf SV Weiden e.V.
description: The SV Weiden e.V. Advent Run is a traditional, family-friendly fun run that has been held for more than three decades on the first Sunday of Advent in the Fuchswald forest near the sports grounds in the Rottweil region. The varied course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks and offers runners of all abilities an enjoyable running experience. Alongside the main race and middle-distance race, there are also children’s races and a little ones’ race, making the event suitable for the whole family.
course_highlights: Course runs mostly along forest and farm tracks
Main race: 10.7 km; middle-distance race: 5.9 km
Children’s races and a little ones’ race on the sports field and field paths
additional: The Advent Run is open to Nordic walkers, recreational runners and competitive runners. Numerous training plans are available to help participants prepare. More than 200 runners take part, and the children’s races attract 28 children and young people. The 350 m little ones’ race takes place on the sports field. The courses are close to nature and family-friendly, with Nordic walking options.

name: Argenthaler Quarzit Adventstrail
description: The Argenthaler Quarzit Advent Trail is a trail-running event taking place on November 29, 2026, in Argenthal in the Hunsrück. The race gives runners the opportunity to experience the winter scenery of the Soonwald on a challenging course. The event is organized by LLG Hunsrück, which has hosted this festive trail adventure during Advent for more than a decade. The event is known for its festive atmosphere and scenic route through winter landscapes.
course_highlights: Route through the Soonwald in the Hunsrück
Festive atmosphere during Advent
Scenic winter landscapes
additional: The race is known for its festive atmosphere and Christmas-themed supporting program. The exact course distance is not specified, but the event is a popular winter and Advent race for trail runners.

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
description: The Bertlich Road Races in Herten are a traditional running event taking place on November 29, 2026. The event offers distances from 850 meters up to the marathon on flat, paved routes around Bertlich, ideal for runners of all ability levels. Participants can register in person on race day and benefit from refreshment stations, certificates, and medals. The event is family-friendly and features a pleasant supporting program in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Distances from 850 meters to 30 kilometers
Flat, paved routes through a local recreation area
Varied supporting program with refreshments and certificates
additional: Registration is open until September 27, 2024; late registration is available online until race day. Start and finish near the sports field on Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße. Parking is available at Marktkauf Herten. Changing and shower facilities are available on site. Finishers receive certificates and medals.

name: FORD Advent-Lauf
location: Leinpfad, Daarler Brücke, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The FORD Advent Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Saarbrücken, on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. It is part of the Sparkassen City Run Series and offers a range of distances—10 km, 5 km and 2 km—for experienced runners, beginners and children. The event is organised by SV GO! Saar 05 Leichtathletik e.V., with support from SparkasseSB, Ford and LottoSaartoto. Registration is through meisterchip.de, and the courses are officially measured, allowing results to qualify for rankings.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke in Saarbrücken
Part of the Sparkassen City Run Series
2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances for different groups of runners
additional: Typical November weather, with an average temperature of 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C and rainy days. The race is listed in the German running calendar system, and the courses are officially measured. The race takes place in Saarbrücken, with the start and finish on the Leinpfad at Daarler Brücke. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and is a great opportunity to kick off the Advent season with some exercise.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbach Winter Running and Walking Series is a long-standing series in the Langenhain Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, held on five Sundays during the winter months. Participants can choose between 10 km and 20 km routes, which are permanently signposted and can also be used for walking or hiking. The start is free, there is no timing, and the event is all about running together without a competitive element. On running Sundays, participants are served tea at a refreshment station, and coffee and biscuits are available in the sports hall after the run. At the final event, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake are also served.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhain Forest
An additional loop for the 20 km route is signposted from late November to mid-February
Hot tea available at the refreshment station near the Bahai’i forest car park (approx. km 6.4)
additional: Starts are individual, with no timing. No registration is required. Participation is free, with voluntary donations welcome. Changing rooms in the sports hall at Schinderwald are open on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00. Coffee and biscuits are available after the run; at the final event, soup and wheat beer are also served. Bring your own collapsible cup for tea. Route profiles are available on Komoot. Routes: 10 km and 20 km; challenging and varied routes; no timing; individual starts; GPS track via Komoot; tea station with tea, coffee, biscuits, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake; changing rooms in the sports hall; parking at the sports field and Park & Ride; no registration required.

name: Pfungstädter Advents-Crosslauf
description: The Pfungstädter Advent Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country event reaching its 57th edition in 2026. The races take place on an established course with cross-country conditions and offer appealing competitions for all age groups, from children to seniors. The event is part of the Langlaufcup and the HLV Darmstadt-Dieburg District Cross-Country Series. Staggered start times make for exciting races across various distances and age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of approx. 3,700 m for the middle-distance race
Long-distance race of approx. 7,300 m over 6 cross-country laps
Sprint course of approx. 850 m for children and youth
additional: Race packets for schools will be distributed on the hard-surface court; all other participants can collect theirs in the youth room. No late entries or changes are possible on site. Start times are approximate and may be changed slightly. Online registration only, until 28.11.2025; no late entries on site; refreshments available; toilets in the Ludwig-Crössmann-Heim; no changing or shower facilities.

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the fourth race in the Jedermannlauf series and offers runners of all ages and ability levels an attractive opportunity to compete. The event is organised by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course passes through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sport and is aimed at children, young people and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the Jedermannlauf series
Various categories for all age groups
Race in the historic town of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is by email. The event includes running and cycling events, as well as filters for terrain and sport type.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held in late November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter Bambini run to a 10 km run for adults. The course runs mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports ground. Every participant receives a Stutenkerl, and awards are presented promptly after each race, with prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial-turf pitch on Buchenweg (Bambini run)
10 km run mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at the Buchenweg sports ground; no traditional city-center course
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race bib, provided by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are available on the event day or online later. Parking is signposted at Heinrich Böll Comprehensive School and at the Schmachtendorfer Straße market square. Distances: 300 m Bambini run and 10 km for adults; course on forest trails and sports grounds; children’s and adult categories; November weather may be rainy.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Weihnachtsmarktlauf
description: The Christmas Market Run in Landstuhl is a traditional race held annually on November 30. With a 7.6 km main race and a 1.3 km students’ race, it offers a sporting challenge for various age groups. The event is organized by LLG Landstuhl e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scoring for clubs and groups. Registration is open from October 15 to November 28, and on-site registration is available.
course_highlights: 7.6 km main race
1.3 km students’ race
Age-group scoring and group competition
additional: Registration is open from October 15 to November 28. On-site registration is available. There are performance and group competitions, with prize money for the top participants and groups. The race takes place on November 30. Online registration is available, with prizes for individual and group competitions. The course runs through the festively decorated town.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross-Country Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr. Its cross-country course takes runners through wintry nature in keeping with the Advent season. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, and is held in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The awards ceremony and certificate distribution take place right next to the course, creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere. A catering stand in the finish area serves hot and cold drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through the natural surroundings of Essen-Überruhr
Age-group categories from U8 through seniors M/W 80
Awards ceremony and certificate distribution right next to the course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area; the recommended parking location is Marktplatz Überruhr (approx. 500 m on foot). Public transport is available via bus routes SB15, 144, 166, and 177. Catering in the finish area includes hot and cold drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The race takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, in typical November weather, with temperatures around 2–7°C and frequent rain. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held on site.

name: TRAILS - Flyvestationen
description: Trails - Flyvestationen 2025 is a race taking place on Sunday, November 30, 2025, at Flyvestation Værløse. The area is a unique trail destination
