name: Surpriseloop Halsteren
description: The Surpriseloop takes place on Sunday, December 1, 2024, in the “De Melanen” nature reserve in Halsteren. The event is organized by Atletiek

name: Pietenloop Bemmel
location: Sportpark De Heister, Bemmel, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Pietenloop is a small, friendly recreational run in Bemmel, suitable for the whole family. Children can choose from three distances (400, 800 and 1,200 metres), starting on the athletics track, while adults take part in a 5 km run through the countryside around Bemmel. The Pieten are there to lead the warm-up and run alongside the children, giving the event a festive atmosphere. The start is at De Heister sports park, where changing rooms and showers are also available. After the run, there is a treat for everyone, and young participants receive a lovely Pieten medal.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 400, 800 and 1,200 metres on the athletics track
Recreational 5 km run through Haalderen and along the Waal dike, free of traffic
Start and finish at De Heister sports park, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: The Pieten lead the warm-up for children at 9:45. There is no electronic timekeeping; a central clock is used. The first-, second- and third-place finishers in the children’s races and the 5 km will be listed on the website. Food and drinks can be paid for by QR code in the clubhouse. The venue opens at 9:00 for race-number collection. A family-friendly event for children with Pieten, held at De Heister sports park in Bemmel.

name: Run Rondje Rhenoy
description: Run Rondje Rhenoy is an autumn classic being held for the 20th time this year in Beesd. The race takes place on Sunday 29 November 2026 at 13:00 and features a beautiful course through the villages of Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy. After the race, there will be a friendly get-together and a prize draw, with great prizes to be won, including a voucher for running shoes. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over for the 5 km, and aged 16 and over for the 10.8 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Course through Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy
Start and finish at rvv BRC, Sportstraat 7, Beesd
Autumn classic with a friendly get-together and prize draw after the race
additional: Registration desk open from 11:30 to 12:50. Briefing at 13:00. Prize-giving and prize draw around 14:30. Event closes at 15:30. Entry for the 5 km is open to participants aged 12 and over; the 10.8 km is open to participants aged 16 and over. Participation is at your own risk. After the race, there will be an opportunity to chat over a drink and a snack in the sports club canteen. The main prize in the draw is a €150 voucher for running shoes at Sporthuis De Jager. The race starts and finishes at RVV BRC, Sportstraat 7, with the start at 13:02 and prize-giving around 14:30. Registration opens at 11:30, and the event closes at 15:30. A cycling event is also being organized on the same day by BBB Bike Boys.

name: Sint Nicolaasloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: kidsrun 1,5km (4 t/m 9 jr en 10 t/m 12 jr): € 5,00 (2026)

description: The Sint Nicolaasloop in Zwolle is an annual running event held on one of the last Sundays before 5 December, Sinterklaas. The event offers four distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run, and the 5 km, 8 km and 10 English miles for adults. The course runs through the beautiful countryside north of Zwolle, past the Berkum and AA-landen districts, and is suitable for runners of all ages and abilities. The event is organised by an enthusiastic group of volunteers from the SNL running group, who provide a welcoming and well-organised race experience.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside north of Zwolle
Route past the Berkum and AA-landen districts
Clear yellow route arrows and guidance for the fastest runners
additional: Race numbers with chips are not sent by post and can be collected on Friday evening or Sunday morning at SV HTC. All participants receive a running shirt; participants who register before 1 October can specify their size. Parking near the start is limited, so cycling is recommended. No late registration is available. Runners with disabilities may take part in the kids’ run regardless of age. The course is not closed to traffic; traffic marshals provide guidance where needed. Registration opens from 1 September 2026 via inschrijven.nl; the maximum number of participants is 1000. The course is marked with yellow arrows; traffic marshals will be present; race numbers and shirts can be collected at the venue.

name: Tis voor niks
description: ’T is voor niks is a friendly running and walking event in Geldrop, held annually since 1999. Participation is free thanks to the efforts of many volunteers and sponsors. Five distances are available, ranging from 6 to 25 kilometres, with the start and finish at Café Brabants Bont and Winkelcentrum Coevering. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Café Brabants Bont, next to the sports hall and Winkelcentrum Coevering
Refreshment stations with water, gingerbread, coffee and tea at two locations for the longer distances
Clearly marked routes with arrows; walkers do not receive route sheets
additional: Walkers start individually or in groups from the event office at Wijkgebouw De Dreef. Timekeeping stops at 14:30, and all participants must have finished by then. If participants are running late, the organisers may direct them onto a shorter route. Changing and freshening up are available at Sporthal De Coevering from 9:30. Personal drinks can be dropped off at the information stand before 9:30 for transport to the refreshment station. Multiple distances, organised annually, succeeded by Lucas Klamer Half Marathon.

name: Warandeloop (Zondag)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Tot 1 oktober hanteren we een voor-inschrijfkorting op de wedstrijdonderdelen.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Vanaf 1 oktober tot en met 20 november kun je zonder korting inschrijven en komt je naam op je startnummer.

description: The Warandeloop in Tilburg is a versatile cross-country running event with a broad program for different categories, including youth, masters, recreational runners and the Dutch National Cross Country Championships. The event takes place on Sunday, 29 November 2026, and offers challenging courses in a natural setting. The Warandeloop is known for its rich history and for combining sporting achievements with a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A variety of cross-country courses suitable for all ages and abilities
Dutch National Cross Country Championship races for seniors, U18, U20 and masters
Natural, challenging terrain in Tilburg
additional: Online late registration is available until half an hour before each event via the website. On-site payments cannot be made in cash or by card; you must show your registration confirmation on your mobile phone to receive your race number. Three-day event with approximately 5,000 participants and 6,000 spectators, including the special evening run ‘Warande by Night’ and photo and video coverage.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Doorn
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two laps, each more than 50 km, run on Saturday and Sunday, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose one of the 50+ km ultras or run the full 109 km over two days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two 50+ km laps across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: UHUT100 Winter is split over two days because of the short daylight hours in November. Participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race bib. The route is navigated entirely via GPX, and refreshments are provided every 10–15 km. Finish both days before 17:00. Parking is available at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin; follow the instructions of the parking attendants. Route split over 2 days, start at 09:00, finish before 17:00, navigation via GPX, no cups at aid stations, parking at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

name: JulekalenderLØBET
description: The Christmas Calendar RUN is an exciting race held in Frederikshavn. Participants can look forward to a festive atmosphere where they can run in

name: Sinterklaasloop Bolsward
description: The Sinterklaas Run in Bolsward is a friendly, traditional running race held annually on the last Monday before Sinterklaas. The route runs through and around Bolsward and covers 7.2 kilometres. The race starts at 19:00 at Sporthal De Middelzee. Electronic timing is used, and approximately 25 traffic marshals are on hand to ensure safety. Participants are asked to wear reflective clothing and/or lights for their own safety.
course_highlights: Route through and around Bolsward
Distance of 7.2 kilometres
Starts at Sporthal De Middelzee at 19:00
additional: Registration on the day is not possible. Participants are electronically timed. Sponsor Sporthuis AP van der Feer makes it possible to win prizes in a draw using your race number as your lottery number. Approximately 25 traffic marshals help ensure a safe race. Reflective clothing and/or lights are recommended. The race starts at Sporthal De Middelzee. Registration is online only, with no same-day registration. Participants are advised to wear reflective clothing. There are no official performance prizes, but there are prize draws for participants.

name: Kolding Light Run 2026 powered by Andelskassen
Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christmas market in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for the festive season. The course is a five-lap circuit of approximately 10.2 km and has not been officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christmas market
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for the festive season
Approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Race-pack collection on 5.12.2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Online registration only, opening on 8.10.2025 at 21:00. No race-day registration. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earbuds is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, to allow others to lap them. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a trail race in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between one 5 km lap or two laps for 10 km. The course runs mostly on firm forest paths, with some sections on asphalt, making it suitable for both beginners and runners looking for a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and stands against homophobia in sport by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event welcomes a diverse field of runners, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt’s Goldstein City Forest
Firm forest paths with some sections on asphalt
Part of the long-running FVV XMAS Tournament, with more than 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: In addition to the run, the FVV XMAS Tournament includes a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The FVV XMAS Tournament weekend also features social events such as a party, brunch, and city tour, and supports LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheim Nikolauslauf is a long-standing running event hosted by LG Forchheim on the Sportinsel in Forchheim. The 46th edition takes place on December 5, 2026, and features races for children and young people, a 5.3 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The course follows a new route heading south, with the 10 km race making four circuits around the Sportinsel. The event regularly attracts more than 600 participants and offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races in the morning, starting at 11:20 a.m.
5.3 km fun run on a new route heading south (4 laps)
10 km main race with four laps around the Sportinsel
additional: Start times: children’s and youth races from 11:20 a.m., 5.3 km fun run at 1:00 p.m., 10 km main race at 2:00 p.m. The 5.3 km course is run four times heading south; the 10 km course is run four times around the Sportinsel. Various race categories, festive atmosphere, traditional December event, children’s and youth races, 5.3 km fun run, 10 km main race.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various distances for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 12 km trail run. Runners can look forward to a varied course in a sporty, family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5.
course_highlights: Children’s races with age-appropriate courses
5 km fitness run and walking on varied terrain
12 km trail run with sections close to nature
additional: The Nikolauslauf takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. Various race distances are available for different age and ability groups. Results and rankings from previous races are available to download. The event takes place on December 5, 2026, with course analyses, elevation details, and downloadable results. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt
Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall; participants are usually local club members and recreational runners.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event that has taken place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series comprises four events, each offering 5 km and 10 km distances, starting at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion. Alongside the sporting competition, community spirit is also a key focus, supported by team scoring for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The event is easy to reach by public transport and offers professional timing with a chip attached to each race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau-Energie-Stadion in Rodgau-Jügesheim
5 km and 10 km distances
Easy to reach by S-Bahn (S1), with only a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team scoring is available for teams of three (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with gun-time recording by MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Series dates: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with team scoring also available. The routes are on paved and asphalted forest paths, which often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to help runners prepare for the races.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus-Trail Pommelsbrunn
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Nikolaus Trail in Pommelsbrunn offers trail running and hiking in the picturesque Hersbrucker Schweiz in the Nürnberger Land. On December 5, 2026, runners can choose from four challenging routes ranging from 10 km to a marathon, and families can take part in the Wichtel Trail. The trails are well marked and cross varied terrain with some challenging climbs, making them ideal for both ambitious runners and beginners. A free shuttle service makes getting there easier, and there are special options for trail runners with dogs.
course_highlights: Four routes from 10 km to a marathon, with challenging climbs
Well-marked trails in the Hersbrucker Schweiz
Wichtel Trail for families and special trails for runners with dogs
additional: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, the XL and L trails and the Wichtel Trail take place; on Sunday, December 6, 2026, the S and M trails take place, including options for runners with dogs. A free shuttle service runs from parking areas in Happurg to the start and finish area. The routes are fully marked, and participants receive a voucher code 14 days before the event for a free Komoot route download. Parking in Pommelsbrunn is limited, so travel by public transport is recommended. Trails with up to 1,582 meters of elevation gain, aid stations, well-marked routes, GPS downloads available.

name: Grønbroløbet - Julespecial
description: Grønbroløbet - Christmas Special takes place on December 2, 2023, with a start at 9:00 a.m. from Grønbrovej 1, 4262 Sandved (Grønbrohallen). The route is a bla

name: Sint Joostertrimloop
description: On Saturday, December 7, vv St. Joost is organizing the 472nd Sint Joostertrimloop. The course is laid out in the woods around the sports park "Tu

name: Bovenboerloop
description: The Bovenboerloop is an annual running event in Nijeveen, organised by triathlon club TZT'86. It offers a half marathon and an 11.4 km race, starting at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex. Participants can make use of facilities including medical care, hot showers, changing rooms and refreshment stations every 5 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere, and every participant receives a keepsake.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 11.4 km race
Refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex in Nijeveen
additional: Collect your race number on 5 December between 11:00 and 12:30 at the Dos'46 canteen. Medical care and hot showers are available. You can cancel up to 2 days before the event via info@tzt86.nl. Every participant receives a keepsake. Running course, registration opens on 1 October, event on 5 December 2026

name: Sinterklaasloop Katwijk
description: The Sinterklaasloop Katwijk is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful parts of the Dutch coast. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always great, and the event is open to all ages. Join in and experience running at its best in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500 m Kidsrun at 09:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 09:35, 2 km Kidsrun at 09:45, and 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results in the circuit. The event offers various distances and categories, with GPX routes and results available.

name: Sint Nicolaasloop
location: atletiekbaan bij Quo Vadis, Bunschoten-Spakenburg, Netherlands
price_range: voorinschrijving tot 4 december 2026, na-inschrijving op de dag zelf
description: The Sint-Nicolaasloop is an annual race through the beautiful Eempolder between Bunschoten and Eemdijk, with distances of 5, 10 and 15 km. The start and finish are at the athletics track at Quo Vadis. The 10 and 15 km courses run counterclockwise, with 15 km runners completing an extra loop on Gasthuisweg. Younger runners up to age 12 can take part in a 1.2 km kids’ run. The first, second and third place finishers in each distance receive a prize, for both women and men.
course_highlights: Race through the Eempolder between Bunschoten and Eemdijk
The 10 and 15 km courses run counterclockwise, with an extra loop on Gasthuisweg for the 15 km
Start and finish at the athletics track at Quo Vadis
additional: The 1.2 km kids’ run starts at 10:00 (3 laps of the track). The 5 km fun run starts at 10:50 from the track. Pre-registration is open until 4 December 2026 at 23:59; on-the-day registration is available from 09:00 to 10:00. Participation is at your own risk. Participants are encouraged to read the general information page; prizes are awarded to the top three in each distance and category.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held every December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and schoolchildren’s run and a 5 km run, each over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/schoolchildren’s run over 2 laps
5 km run over 2 laps
Route through the village of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event for use in the press and on social media. Participant data is used to compile the race results and can be deleted on request. Terrain: loop course of 0.5 km or 2.5 km; online registration until 12.12.2025; trophies, certificates and a raffle; weather-dependent conditions, with possible snow cover and temperatures around 3°C.

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany
price_range: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 EUR, ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR, zusätzliche Servicegebühr bei Anmeldung am Tag vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 Euro bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Brandschutz Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. It offers short road-race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organised by the athletics section of TV Ottweiler. Registration is available for individuals and groups, making it easier for teams to sign up.
course_highlights: Short road-race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Winter race with typical December temperatures around 3 °C; roads are often snow-covered
Starting point in Ottweiler
additional: The race is usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. Younger runners are eligible for the 2.5 km race; higher minimum age limits apply to the 5 km and 10 km races. Group registration is also available, making it straightforward for teams to sign up. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with roads often snow-covered. Winter race, road race, individual or group registration available, age limits vary by distance.

name: Svinninge Juleløb
description: Svinninge Christmas Run is an annual running competition held in Svinninge, Holbæk. The race offers a beautiful route through scenic areas o

description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bennekom is a fun event where participants, dressed as Santa Claus, walk or run a course to raise money for

name: OVM DEO Loop
description: On Saturday, December 13, 2025, the 44th edition of the OVM-DEOloop will take place, a true cross-country race with a challenging and largely unpaved

name: Run Forest Run Dwingelderveld
description: The RUNFORESTRUN Dwingelderveld crosses the stunning wet heathland, with pools, small lakes, woodland and drifting sand in the southwest of

name: Mas Montagne Trail
description: The Mas Montagne Trail running event offers a unique experience around Amerongse Berg, with challenging loops passing the Eenzame Eik, single t

name: Ameland Adventure Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km, plus children’s distances; registration opens on 1 April; winter conditions are possible; location: Nes, Ameland.

name: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra
location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaning Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages from December to February. It offers races for different age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km and a half marathon, as well as races for schoolchildren and speed races. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active in winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes getting there easier, and refreshments at the finish invite participants to linger.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km and half marathon courses
Separate races for schoolchildren and speed races for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish refreshments; participants may bring their own cup. Free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Races for schoolchildren and speed races for U16 and older. GPX course files are available. The event also includes youth and speed races, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Aachen Winter Run is a traditional 16.1-kilometre race from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg. Held annually in December, it attracts many runners of all ages. The route passes through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen, offering varied and scenic running. The event is well organised, with race bib collection available on several days, a bus transfer to the start and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 16.1 km route from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen, with a heated indoor area and refreshments
additional: Race bibs can be collected at various locations on several days before the race. Free bus transport from Chorusberg to the start is available from 8:15 a.m.; taking an early bus is recommended. Bürgerhaus Venwegen is heated and serves as a place to wait and get refreshments. Clothing is transported from the start to the finish. Late entries are not possible. Starting places can be transferred up to one hour before the race via the individual change link or by email. The Winter Run takes place on 13 December 2026; further information about start times, registration and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with singletrack trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges and past rock formations. Participants need suitable equipment and experience handling winter conditions, as runners are self-sufficient. The course is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and there is a course briefing before the run. This is not a road race, but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: A high proportion of singletrack, with many technical sections
Winter scenery in the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park, with moss-covered forests and waterways
Sections crossing small bridges and passing rock formations and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is required, especially for the longer distances. The course will be confirmed shortly before the race and made available to download. The longer distances are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced, and sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for walkers. Aid stations are available on the longer distances. A headlamp is recommended and mandatory for the long distance. Winter trails, technical sections, no walkers permitted, mandatory equipment required, course changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is an atmospheric race in Zell an der Mosel, traditionally held during Advent. The event offers runners a festive atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all ages and ability levels, combining sporting ambition with Christmas spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Moselle landscape
Festive Advent atmosphere
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Multiple categories, registration from September to December, event on December 13, 2026

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: Der Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf ist ein Crosslauf, der kurz vor Weihnachten im Ravensberger Stadion in Borgholzhausen stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung wird vom LCS Olbä organisiert und bietet verschiedene Distanzen an, darunter 16 km, 10 km, 5 km sowie eine 7,5 km Walking/Nordic Walking Strecke. Die 16 km Strecke besteht aus zwei Runden mit teils hügeligem Gelände rund um Borgholzhausen und einer Schleife um den Barenberg, die zweimal durchlaufen wird. Die Strecke ist eine echte Crosslauf-Herausforderung mit Auf- und Abstiegen, wobei Start- und Zielabschnitte auf befestigten Wegen liegen, auf denen Spikes nicht erlaubt sind. Der Lauf zieht ein vielfältiges Teilnehmerfeld an, von starken Spitzenläufern bis zu Freizeit- und älteren Läufern sowie Walkern.

name: Juleløbet Skamling - Et anderledes Juleeventyr
description: Held since 2012 in the historic, hilly surroundings on and around Skamlingsbanken, with routes for the whole family. From the family route to

name: Mescherbergloop
description: Welcome to the Mescherbergloop, a true classic among hill races in the Netherlands, which has been making runners’ hearts beat faster for more than 30 years

name: Texel Wintercross
location: De Dennen, Turfveld Nattevlakweg, start hoek Fazantenlaan-Heidvlakweg.
description: The Texel Wintercross takes place in De Dennen on Texel, near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. This race is sheltered in the forest, with winding trails.

name: Dijkloop Delfzijl
distance_verbose: Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: Winterse social run Utrecht - Run Your City
Ter Specke Loop
location: Sportpark Ter Specke, Lisse, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, korting voor verzekerden van Zorg en Zekerheid
description: The Ter Specke Loop takes place in the beautiful, wooded surroundings of Sportpark Ter Specke in Lisse. The distinctive course is flat and sheltered, with the start on Spekkelaan and the finish on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with runners completing one to three laps. Families and the youngest participants can take part in the free 1 km GeZZinsloop, with a medal for everyone afterward. After the finish, runners are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.
course_highlights: Flat, sheltered course in a wooded setting
Start on Spekkelaan, finish on the athletics track
Distances of 1 km (GeZZinsloop), 5 km, 10 km and 15 km
additional: Registration takes place in the sports hall, with card payment. Separate changing rooms are available for women and men. Valuables can be left in a tent on the track. Massage may be available in the sports hall afterward. Parking is available on Spekkelaan, at the cycling track and on van Lyndenweg, as directed by parking attendants. Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like via the information desk; switching to the long distance is only possible through individual registration. Various distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 1 km kids' run), start and finish at Sportpark Ter Specke, on-site registration with card payment, free kids' run, massage available afterward

name: Urban City Run 053
description: The Urban City Run 053 takes place on December 13, 2026, in Enschede and offers participants a unique 5 km or 7.5 km exploratory run through the city centre. The start and finish are at Performance Factory, and the course takes you past attractive squares, streets and various buildings. This is not a race and there is no timekeeping, so you can enjoy the special moments along the way and take selfies. All participants receive a unique running shirt, which serves as their entry pass and must be worn. After the finish, you can chat together over food and drinks.
course_highlights: Varied course through Enschede city centre, including asphalt, carpet and grass
Run through various buildings and climb several staircases
Start and finish at Performance Factory
additional: Maximum of 2,000 participants. Start waves between 09:00 and 10:00; choose your start time when registering. Minimum age: 12. The running shirt is mandatory and serves as your entry pass. Start and finish at Performance Factory, start waves between 09:00 and 10:00, minimum age 12, no showers, luggage storage at your own risk.

name: Wintercross ASV Eibergen
description: The Wintercross ASV Eibergen is a challenging cross-country running event that is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. The race takes place in the beautiful natural area around Eibergen and offers distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The competition encourages runners of all ages to enjoy athletics in a welcoming and sporting environment. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs, ensuring a professional and friendly experience.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km
A natural and challenging cross-country course in Eibergen
Races for youth, seniors and masters
additional: The races start at 10:30 with the 10 km for seniors and masters. This is followed by various youth distances from 1 km to 5 km. The age reference date for youth and masters is the final race and the first race of the competition, respectively. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs from the region. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl, with on-site registration also possible; the event is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held at RCN campsite Zeewolde. It offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both beginners and experienced runners and is organised by TVZ Zeewolde, a sports club with a rich history in multisport and triathlon. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, with an emphasis on having fun and enjoying the event together.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN campsite Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Registration is required; the event takes place during the winter months and is suitable for the whole family.

name: Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestre
description: The Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestrecross is a classic cross-country race organised annually by AVR'69 in Reusel. The technical course features several hills and bends and is located at Burgemeester Willekenslaan. The race attracts a strong field, including many Belgian runners, and is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie. Before the race, there is a fun run open to everyone, starting at 1120 metres. The start and finish are at De Oude Brandtoren in Reusel.
course_highlights: Technical course with several hills
Plenty of bends
Located on Burgemeester Willekenslaan in Reusel
additional: Start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren, Burgemeester Willekenslaan 2, Reusel. The cross is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie, a series of 7 cross-country races in region 14 (Kempen). Medals are awarded to the first 3 participants in each race category. The short cross has 2 categories: Men and Women. Pupils without a competition licence or club membership may take part and can also reach the podium. Registration on the day of the race is not possible. Course with hills and bends; registration until 12 December; start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren; various categories, including a fun run for all ages.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: Santa Run
description: The Rotary Santa Run is a fun run where participants dress as Santa Claus and run or walk a course of approximately 3 kilometres for charity. The event was launched in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon, with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and a few abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were held in 58 cities, raising a combined total of more than €450,000 for over 100 good causes. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform look and a powerful mass start on the Saturday before Christmas.
course_highlights: Short and simple course of approximately 3 km
Participants dressed as Santa Claus
Uniform nationwide look with simultaneous starts
additional: The Rotary Santa Run is organised by local Rotary Clubs, with support from a starter package that includes Santa suits, medals, race numbers, promotional materials and an online registration module. Each location has a minimum of 240 participants, and the event is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organisation is a turnkey concept, with an operations manual, an emergency plan and a uniform look. Participants dress as Santa Claus and support good causes; the event takes place in multiple cities and has a strong focus on charity and community spirit.
