name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area

Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year's Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s race, a 4.8 km fun run and a 9.2 km long-distance race, it offers a sporting option for all ages and ability levels. The race is popular with runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a chance to end the year on an athletic note. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.

additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf

The event is organized by TSV Ottenbach and is a popular meeting point for the regional running community.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.

The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

price_range: 200 Kč předem, na místě zdarma pro děti
description: The Silvestrovský běh in Karviná is a traditional 10 km road race held every year on December 31. The route runs along the city’s outer streets and features more than 100 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenge for every runner. The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs along the outer streets of Karviná
More than 100 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races in the forest park over distances of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m and 1.8 km
additional: Registration is open from 8:30 to 9:45. The children’s races start at 10:05. The main route is on paved roads; the children’s races take place in the forest park. Refreshments after the race include goulash soup and tea, with rum available. Registered athletes are entered by their clubs; parents enter unregistered children. The race starts at 10:00, and the children’s races start at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi
description: The Havlovice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running race organized by Maratonstav Physical Education Association Úpice and held annually on New Year’s Eve in Havlovice. The event offers a 6.6 km main race on a new four-lap course, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. It is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth runners, and concludes with New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race: 6.6 km — 4 laps on a new course
Start and finish at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice
New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish
additional: Children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Registration is open until 9:30 for the children’s categories and until 10:30 for the main race. The event includes the main course and children’s categories; race day concludes with festive refreshments; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Zlín is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve, offering 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer courses. The main 10 km race consists of two laps on an out-and-back route along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including young people and juniors, and is part of the Běhy Zlín series. Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The route follows the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back
The main race is 10 kilometers long, split into two laps
A shorter 5-kilometer course is also available for young people and juniors
additional: Online registration is open until December 30 at 12:00; on-site registration on race day is open until 10:40. Winners are announced at 12:45 at the race registration venue. Age categories are according to the rules of the Běhy Zlín series. Category winners receive prizes, subject to the organizer’s options. 5 km and 10 km races, online registration, category winner announcements, photos and results available

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The Silvestr Stříbro Run is a traditional year-end running race held in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course, mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI complex. It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro complex
Option to start at 10:00 or 10:30, depending on the runner’s pace
additional: After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments. The entry fee can be paid in advance by email or on site at the KERMI complex, training center. The race includes a trail at KERMI and a historic city run. Registration is available on site or by email. The start is at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Silvestrovský běh - memoriál Richarda Plcha
location: Park Pod Plachtami, Brno-Nový Lískovec, Brno, Jihomoravský, Czech Republic
price_range: 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin; 200 Kč – na místě

description: The Silvester Run – Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the AC Moravská Slavia Brno athletics club. It takes place on 31 December in Brno-Nový Lískovec, in Pod Plachtami Park, and offers races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Runners can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a 1.64 km fun run, and children’s races starting at 100 m. The course is asphalt with a mix of paved paths, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere as they end the year on the move.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface combined with paved paths
Routes for all age groups, from 100 m to 9.84 km
Held in Pod Plachtami Park in Brno-Nový Lískovec
additional: Check-in is required no later than 30 minutes before the start of each category at ZŠ Svážná 438/9; it opens at 8:00. Changing rooms are available at ZŠ Svážná and are for changing only; the organizers are not responsible for belongings left there. Results will be posted throughout the event in the start/finish area and later published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The first three finishers in each category will receive prizes, and children will receive a small prize at the finish. In the fun run, prizes will be drawn among three runners. Entering two races is permitted only for categories up to and including older pupils. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration runs from 20. 11. 2025 to 29. 12. 2025; the event includes various age categories and a fun run open to all birth years.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kolín New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional three-kilometre race held in Borky Forest Park. In 2026, the race will take place in an unusual format: the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can complete it individually. Results can be sent to the organisers by email or SMS, after which the results list will be published. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the course follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue, finishing at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometre course in Borky Forest Park
Start by the FK Kolín artificial-turf football pitch
The route follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue past STAP
additional: The race can be completed individually between December 30 and January 1, with results submitted by email or SMS. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the finish is on the cycle path by the athletics stadium. The results list will be published on January 2. The race will not be held as a conventional mass start due to pandemic-related restrictions. Modified format due to the pandemic; individual participation; the course is marked from December 30 to January 1; results submitted by email or SMS; results published on January 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year’s Eve–New Year’s Day Metropolis Run is a unique sporting event held in Prague at night, just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is for recreational runners as well as more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year together in an active, sporting way. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 23:50. Registration is available in advance and on race day.
course_highlights: A night run in Prague’s unique atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
The last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also available at the race-day check-in desk. Detailed information about the course, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, registration at www.behmetropole.cz, course and safety information on the website

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year’s Eve Run, held on December 31, starting at 10:00 from the boathouse. Men run 7.5 km, while women, junior women and junior men run 5 km, consisting of two 2.5 km laps. The race offers a pleasant end-of-year atmosphere and the chance to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Přerov. You can register online in advance or at the race office on the day of the event. We look forward to seeing you!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boathouse and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km; women and juniors run 5 km (two 2.5 km laps)
Start at 10:00 from the boathouse
additional: Registration is available in advance via an online form or at the race office on the day of the event. The course is a 2.5 km loop: boathouse – skatepark – boathouse. Men run three laps (7.5 km), while women and juniors run two laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026. Registration is available online or on-site on race day. Start at 10:00.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase
location: Roudnice nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run from Hasa to Hasa is a traditional New Year's Eve run in Roudnice nad Labem, now being held for the 42nd time. The race offers a simple, easy-to-follow format, with times recorded using chip timing. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants enjoy a beautiful race at the end of the year. Check-in takes place from 8:30 in the Elbe River Board building in Roudnice nad Labem.
course_highlights: A traditional New Year's Eve run with high participation
Chip timing
Start and check-in at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228
additional: Check-in from 8:30 at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228, Roudnice n.L. The start is between 10:00 and 11:00. The race is simple and easy to follow, and suitable for the general public. It is part of a regional celebration attended by runners and organizers from Sokol and local partners. The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop De Wilp is a welcoming running event held annually in the picturesque village of De Wilp. With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque Groningen-Frisian countryside
Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit
additional: Registration is open until 3 January at 23:59 via the website, or from 11:45 until half an hour before the start in the canteen of v.v. De Wilper Boys. Collect your race number no later than 15 minutes before the start. Parking is available in the v.v. De Wilper Boys car park near the canteen. First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; advance registration; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid available; memento and refreshments included.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.

The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

description: The 64th Wallenloop, organised by AV'56 in Goes, is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, 9 January 2027. The race attracts athletes from the region and offers a challenging course through the city of Goes. The organisers provide a sporting and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The Wallenloop is an important event on the Zeeland running calendar and is known for its good organisation and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the historic centre of Goes
Varied surfaces, including city roads
Atmospheric winter race in January
additional: The General Terms and Conditions for Running Events apply to AV'56 races. Shoe checks may be carried out in accordance with the competition rules in the case of outstanding performances. The organisers can be reached via the contact form on the website and by telephone during races at 0113-230788. Race categories range from 900 metres to 7,560 metres. Online registration is possible until a few days before the race; no on-site registration is mentioned.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition
Distances: 1,500 m for children, 5 km and 10 km for adults, with laps of 750 m and 5 km
additional: On-the-day registration for individual participation is available until half an hour before the start at the Sportlust Vroomshoop clubhouse. Children run 1,500 metres (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Running Circuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region, consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.
course_highlights: Nine running events through typical Dutch landscapes
Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races
additional: The competition consists of nine races, with standings based on the best six performances. Participants run in age categories and can register for the entire circuit. The races have an informal, sociable atmosphere, with an opportunity to chat and enjoy a drink afterwards. The event features children’s categories followed immediately by the main race. It is part of the Winter Running League and is suitable for the general public, including families with children. The start and registration are held in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, offering easy access and a friendly race atmosphere.

Am Ziel erhalten alle Teilnehmer einen warmen Tee im Sporthaus.

description: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, a winter competition featuring ten unique cross-country races in different villages across Salland. The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country running experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The competition encourages participation in multiple races, with points based on the best performances of the season.
course_highlights: Unique cross-country course in beautiful Salland
Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest trails, meadows and sandy stretches
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of a competition with 10 cross-country races in Salland. The best 6 races count toward the standings (instead of 7). There is a 1 km kids’ run that does not count toward the standings. The organizers place great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in poor weather conditions, as happened recently because of slippery conditions and low feels-like temperatures. Race canceled due to bad weather and safety concerns.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. The organizers provide electronic timing, and showers are available after the race.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo

The officially measured out-and-back course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the spa gardens in Bad Hamm. The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Timing is provided by the Race Result system, and awards are presented to the fastest runners as well as age-group prize winners.

The course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and Bad Hamm spa gardens

Youths and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

The races run through the wintery Hilden City Forest and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, and late entries are possible on site.

description: Rondje Oeken is a welcoming, small-scale running event held in the beautiful countryside around Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths, and is fully marked and largely traffic-free. The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery with rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths
Fully marked and largely traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51, Brummen
additional: There are two start times: 10:00 for the 21.1 km and 10:30 for the 12 km. Parking is available at De Vroolijke Frans and on the field behind it. You can register using the registration form on the website, either in advance or on the day. The event is welcoming and focused on a friendly atmosphere, sportsmanship and safety, with experienced volunteers and first aid on site. The course varies from unpaved paths to trail; there is a children's run, and registration is available on the day. The start is at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a welcoming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic marshals. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive day of sport, with a focus on participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by around 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic marshals. Participants are catered for with water stations along the course, fruit and a memento at the finish. At the 40th anniversary, special treats were handed out, including cream cakes and flower bulbs. There are multiple distances, including a children’s race and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and the surrounding area, with traffic marshals and measures to minimize disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 to 15 kilometers
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; late registration is available on race day from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several junior cross distances. The short and long cross start at 10:00, followed by the junior cross at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.
course_highlights: Unpaved course near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Junior cross with several shorter distances

description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers several distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful natural scenery, and a broad field of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through a Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a welcome with coffee or tea and a treat, followed after the race by pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10EM are assigned based on expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10EM has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; event in February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Erpelkappersloop
description: The Erpelkappersloop in Axel is a traditional race organized annually by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an enjoyable, sporty experience in beautiful surroundings. It is part of a series of events organized by the club, which is known for its varied and well-organized running activities. The Erpelkappersloop promises a sociable and challenging running experience during the winter season.
course_highlights: Organized in Axel, a charming location
A traditional race with a sporty atmosphere
Part of a series of events organized by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas
additional: The race takes place on February 6, 2027, and is aimed at a broad range of runners.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

Participants can enjoy a run in a scenic setting, with high-quality organization and a long-standing tradition.

The course follows the cycle path along the Elbe River
Part of the Winter Running League, with children’s categories

The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.

Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.

Varied course with dune trails and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.

Long straight roads and sturdy drainage canal embankments
Start and finish in the middle of Bleskensgraaf

Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with Melkwegplein and Weideweg preferred. Race-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 has not yet been announced, but the event is popular and sells out quickly. Facilities include parking, first aid, and Ipico timing. There is also an option to donate to a good cause.

description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organized by Iphitos in the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie and offers challenging courses that are entirely off-road, with sandy stretches, tough short hills, and a route along a branch of the River Dinkel. There are several distances for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, held around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Refreshment stations are available on the longer distances, with water at the finish.
course_highlights: Almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
Official timing by MyLaps and refreshment stations on the longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 5 and 10 km walking distances. Walkers start at the same time as the 20 km running race. Youth runners have special distances of 400 m and 1000 m on the track, with a free commemorative item. A massage room offers free massages from Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The cafeteria is open, and a limited number of lockers are available. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a 1 km family run. The half marathon takes you through woodland and dunes and along paved roads, bringing nature and sport together. The venue is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a bag drop. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes looking to enjoy a challenging and varied course.

name: 3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is an atmospheric running race in Driebergen, with three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The routes follow unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways through the beautiful Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates. The race is known for its scenic, demanding courses and its focus on sustainability, with participants encouraged to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the way and at the finish. The organizers provide a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.

Half marathon through the Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates
Refreshment stations with water and sports drink along the route and at the finish

Routes have been adjusted due to area restrictions; registration opens in early December 2026; options are available to transfer race numbers and volunteer; the event takes an environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing is included.

The race starts on the athletics track, after which the course runs mostly off-road through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural surroundings and varied course.

Course runs mostly off-road through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)

The event offers a sporty and enjoyable day, with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km recreational runs. The half marathon starts at 11:00 a.m. and the recreational runs at 11:20 a.m. By taking part, you support Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen, which helps children from families with limited means join sports or cultural clubs.

Fysiotherapie De Dobbe supports participants in getting fit for the start.

name: Königsforst Marathon
description: One of Germany’s six oldest marathons. With 17 small start groups from 08:45 to 14:00. With prizes for course and age-group records. With a single entry fee for all three distances, so you can switch distances at any time at no extra cost. With a reforestation initiative to offset the environmental impact of travel. With a DLV-certified course through nature.
additional:
The course:
The loop through the Königsforst includes several sections of the original 1973 course. The website has a dynamic GPX map of the course and an option to download the GPX file.

The course has only two longer, steeper climbs:

From km 3 to km 4, the route climbs 28 m to “Monte Troodelöh” (Cologne’s highest point). It then descends to the first aid station at km 5.
After km 15, at the “Wassertretstelle” (water-treading pool), you climb 40 m over a distance of 630 m. The third aid station comes shortly afterwards.

You reach the highest point shortly after the third aid station. From here, the route is flat along the path of the former railway line back to Bensberg. In the final kilometre, it leaves the forest after the underpass. 400 m before the finish, turn right and head up Schloßfeldweg.

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is Nijmegen’s city run, taking place on 20 March 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark, and the finish is right in the centre of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The different courses offer varied routes through the city centre, past the city island, along Nijmegen’s skyline and through the natural surroundings of the Ooijpolder. The event combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and invites participants to experience the island’s unique nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and there is plenty of opportunity to enjoy an atmospheric weekend with accommodation available on the island.

The race pack includes a race number with chip and a bus pass for transport on the island. Participants must reserve their own ferry ticket. A running shirt can be ordered. Changes to registration can be made for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with changing and shower facilities. Several distances; registration opens on 1 October 2026; accommodation is available on the island; the event takes place in March.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with tough climbs, sand, and mud. This running event is for all ages, with the start and finish on the event hill at Oldemeijer. Spectators can cheer on the runners from several spots, adding to the lively, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Tough climbs along the course
Route around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake
Sandy and muddy terrain
additional: Race-day registration is possible. The start and finish are on the event hill at Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages, and there are several places for spectators to cheer on the runners. The 3 km course around Oldemeijer is challenging, with climbs, sand, and mud; the start and finish are at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been held for more than 70 years. Each year, the event attracts runners from the region and beyond, who enjoy an active and sociable day. The course is completely flat and has little traffic. It runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the distinctive Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an appealing and fast course. There are distances for all ages, from kids’ runs to 15 kilometres, including supervised youth distances.
course_highlights: Completely flat course with little traffic
Runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometre markers and one lap per distance (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: MYLAPS BibTag timing is used. The chip is attached to the back of the race number and does not need to be returned. Late registration is available on race day from 10:30 until half an hour before the start. The start and finish area is at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the De Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets are available. There are no changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5, 10 and 15 km races for men and women, plus an additional prize for a course record. Registration opens on 1 January 2027 via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and keepsakes for the winners, and preparation training sessions are available. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique, one-time marathon taking place on 20 March 2027 to celebrate 750 years of Alblasserwaard history. The 42.195-kilometre route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk, through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways and villages, to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat-meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the region’s landscape and history at its heart.
course_highlights: Start at Kinderdijk’s 19 windmills, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Route along separated cycle paths and roads with limited traffic
Past historic waterways, polder windmills and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses will run between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not possible and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at both the start and finish. The organisers aim to be sustainable by using biodegradable cups and cleaning the course after the event. Sweeper vehicles are available for runners who drop out. The minimum age to participate is 18. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the region’s history and beauty, with a maximum limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique nighttime running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three events: canicross, trail running and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark, with headlamps permitted only in emergencies, creating a special experience. Registration raises awareness of light pollution through a donation for each participant.
course_highlights: Nighttime route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km for canicross, trail running and the walking tour
Headlamps permitted only in emergencies
additional: The start location and meeting point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. Estimated duration is approximately 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicross participants, and approximately 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog

additional: The start and finish are in different locations, and the route runs along the Rhine.

name: De VoorschotenLoop
description: The VoorschotenLoop is a running race organized by Voorschoten '97 Athletics, held in the beautiful village of Voorschoten. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and is open to everyone, whatever their level. The course is fast and passes some of the village’s most beautiful spots, with various distances for children and adults. The longest distance runs through the scenic countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate. There is also a special Voorschoten Championship for the fastest residents of Voorschoten.
course_highlights: Fast course passing some of Voorschoten’s most beautiful spots
5 km and GeZZinsloop through welcoming neighborhoods
10 km and 10 English miles through the countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate
additional: The GeZZinsloop is free and starts at 10:15 for ages 6–9 and 10:35 for ages 10–12. The start and finish are at Sportpark Adegeest, Weddeloop 6, 2253ST Voorschoten. To take part in the Voorschoten Championship, you must live in Voorschoten and wear a green dot on your race bib, which can be collected beforehand in the canteen. There is no race-day registration. Distances range from 1.25 km to 10 English miles; registration is possible on 21 March; prizes for top participants; championship for Voorschoten residents; prepare with a beginners’ course organized by Voorschoten '97.

description: The Moore DRV Half Westland is a popular half marathon in the Westland, Haaglanden and Rotterdam region, held in Naaldwijk. The race is a fitting finale to the Olympus '70 Runners Project and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The route passes through the polders and alongside greenhouses, with aid stations along the way and a lively start and finish venue at the Olympus '70 athletics facility. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit and offers a varied, fast, traffic-free course.
course_highlights: Route through the polders and alongside greenhouses in the Westland
Aid stations at 6.3, 12.7 and 17.5 km with water and sports drink
Start and finish at the Olympus '70 athletics facility, with changing rooms and showers
additional: The use of reusable SAW timing chips is compulsory; a chip can be ordered for €4,50 when registering. Race numbers can be collected on race day at the Van Dijk Flora indoor hall at Olympus '70. The facility has spacious changing rooms and showers. First aid is available at 17 km and at the finish. Prize ceremonies for various categories. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit. Entries for the half marathon are completely sold out; the event also includes a 10 km, 5 km and a children's walk.

name: Emmy Run
description: De Emmy Run in Slagharen is een gezellig en toegankelijk hardloopevenement voor jong en oud, met afstanden variërend van 1 tot 10 kilometer. De wedstrijd vindt plaats rondom Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy en biedt voor elk wat wils, van de Kidsrun tot een bedrijven- en verenigingenrun. Het evenement staat in het teken van plezier en samen sporten, zonder prijzengeld maar met leuke attenties voor alle deelnemers. Na afloop is er een bescheiden afterparty in de speciale Emmy tent op het kerkplein.

name: Drents Friese Woldmarathon
description: The Drents Friese Wold Marathon is a challenging marathon held in the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park near Diever. The course consists of laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads, mostly through the forest. The marathon has a rich history, with fast course records, and attracts many runners each year who enjoy its natural surroundings. The start and finish are in Diever, and the organizers provide professional chip timing. The marathon is suitable for runners aged 18 and over, with a shorter distance for young people aged 14 and over.
course_highlights: Laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads
Mostly through the wooded surroundings of Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in Diever
additional: Collect your race number on 27 March from 10:00 to 11:45 at the start location. Registration is also available on the day, during the same hours. Timing is by a chip attached to the race number; returning the race number after finishing is strongly requested. Age limits: 18 years for all distances except 10.1 km; 14 years for the 10.1 km. If you withdraw before 24 March, the entry fee will be refunded minus €1 in administration costs. Registration is open until 24 March; start times vary by distance; age limits follow KNAU guidelines; the event promotes sport and experiencing nature.

description: The Dun Alve van Ulst is a running race organized by athletics club RKHAV in Hulst. The race offers a half marathon and a quarter marathon, as well as a kids’ run for children aged 6 to 12. The kids’ run is free and starts at around 11:15 on the athletics track. The half and quarter marathons start at 11:00. Race numbers can be collected at the RKHAV clubhouse at Willem Alexanderstraat 6 in Hulst.
course_highlights: Half marathon and quarter marathon distances
A 1,000-metre kids’ run for children aged 6 to 12
Start and finish at athletics club RKHAV in Hulst
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the RKHAV clubhouse at Willem Alexanderstraat 6 in Hulst. The kids’ run starts at around 11:15 on the athletics track and is 1,000 metres long. On-the-day registration is available between 09:00 and 10:00 at the late-registration rate. Registration is open, with details about deadlines and start times; the location is Willem Alexanderstraat 6, Hulst.

name: Veselská 21 - mezi pískovnami
location: Veselí nad Lužnicí, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Veselská 21 is a running race held in Veselí nad Lužnicí, returning for its second edition on 27 March 2027. The race offers a beautiful course running between sand quarries, creating a unique setting for runners and spectators alike. The event is for all sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a day of sport in nature. Following the success of the first edition, minor changes have been made to enhance the experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A beautiful course between sand quarries
A unique setting for runners and spectators alike
A friendly atmosphere for all sports enthusiasts
additional: The first edition featured a relay alongside the individual half marathon. For 2027, the organizers have announced minor changes compared with the previous edition.

name: Hollen door de Bollen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten bedragen € 14,- per persoon (minimaal 5 personen per team).

description: Hollen door de Bollen is an annual running and walking event in the beautiful Bollenstreek area around Lisse, organised by Stichting Team Bollenstreek in collaboration with AV De Spartaan. All proceeds from the event go to Stichting Roparun, which supports palliative care for cancer patients. Routes range from short children’s runs to 30 km walks, with music and entertainment along the way and a convivial finish. The event puts taking part for charity ahead of competition, with no official timekeeping.
course_highlights: Walking routes of 6.5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 30 km through the Bollenstreek
Running distances of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles
Music and entertainment along the route and a festive finish
additional: The start location is AV De Spartaan, Spekkelaan 8, Lisse. There are various start times for walking and running distances, starting from 07:30. Entries are personal and include a personalised race number; no refunds are available in the event of cancellation. High-visibility vests are recommended on sections of the walking routes that use public roads. A special Shirt Action allows participants to earn a free anniversary shirt by finding sponsors. Routes range from 4.6 km to over 30 km. Advance registration is required; race numbers and shirts can be collected. Volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

description: The Culemborg City Run is an annual running event in Culemborg, with various distances for individual runners, schools, and businesses. The race offers a varied course with distances of 400 metres, 1, 3, 5, and 10 kilometres, suitable for all ages and levels. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the involvement of the local community. The City Run promotes sportsmanship and togetherness in a beautiful urban setting.
course_highlights: Course through the centre of Culemborg
Distances ranging from 400 metres to 10 kilometres
Specific routes for schools and businesses
additional: There are separate categories for schools and businesses. The Roll Run is a special 400-metre race. The event has a varied programme, with different start times for each distance. Attention is given to accessibility and facilities for participants. The event also includes a school run and a business run, along with historical results and sponsors. It is an annual event that brings the community together.

description: The Wielenloop is an annual running event held on Easter Monday in De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen. The event is suitable for all ages, with various distances including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km. The routes offer varied terrain and are accessible to both beginner and experienced runners. The atmosphere is friendly, with space for family and supporters along the route.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Varied terrain suitable for experienced runners
Kids’ run for the youngest runners; participation is free
additional: You can register through the morning of the race, on Monday, at the start. The kids’ run is free. The 5 km and 10 km start at 10:30. There is a warm-up beforehand, and family members can join the kids’ run. On-site registration is possible; the start time is around 10:30; the routes will be announced soon.

name: Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen
description: The Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen is a traditional competitive and recreational race, held for the 60th time on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027. The race offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 km, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. Participants run through the beautiful polder landscape around Aarlanderveen and receive a medal at the finish. Part of the proceeds go to a local good cause; this year, the playground.
course_highlights: All distances follow paved roads around and through the Aarlanderveen polder
Water stations halfway along the course and at the finish
Kilometre markers are displayed along the course, and a running clock is provided
additional: Race numbers will not be mailed out; they can be collected on 29 March at the Dorpshuis during late registration. Timing is provided using MYLAPS BibTag on the race numbers. Parking, changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall on Aarlanderveenseweg. Parking is limited, so cycling is recommended. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km; children's fun run; proceeds go to a good cause (playground); location: Aarlanderveen; organised by AAV'36

name: Klap tot Klaploop

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Klap tot Klaploop is a unique running race with no laps. You travel by bus to the start in Musselkanaal, then run straight back to the centre of Stadskanaal. The flat, fast course is ideal for setting a personal best, while the enthusiastic crowds and friendly atmosphere along the route make for a special experience. The 35th edition takes place on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027—a day of sport, challenge and fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course from Musselkanaal to Stadskanaal
No laps—just one continuous route
The crowds and atmosphere along the route make for a unique experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday before Easter from 10:00 to 14:00 at De Jonge Sport in Stadskanaal, or on the day of the event until 11:30 at the organisers’ tent. Free bus transport is provided from Europalaan in Stadskanaal to the start locations in Musselkanaal for the 5 km and 10 km runners. Wheelchair racers and handcyclists arrange their own transport. Clothing trucks and portable toilets are available at the start locations. There are no showers. Start in Musselkanaal, finish in Stadskanaal; no transport is provided from Stadskanaal to the start locations. The event is supported by local businesses and has a long history, with the 32nd edition in 2027.

name: Paaspolderloop
description: The Paaspolderloop in Nieuwe Niedorp is a friendly running event held on Easter Monday. The race takes you through the beautiful polder, with several distances for all ages, including a 250-metre fun run for the youngest participants and challenging 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over and offers a varied course through meadows and over bridges, including a nostalgic stretch along Dorpsstraat. The organisers create a festive atmosphere with a large prize fund and a quick prize-giving after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful green meadow and sheep path
Several bridges along the course
Nostalgic Dorpsstraat in Nieuwe Niedorp
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Dorpshuis De Prins Maurits. Parking is available at the Winkelcentrum van Nieuwe Niedorp, a 900-metre walk away. There are no changing rooms or showers, but toilets are available in the Dorpshuis. First aid is available at the start/finish. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. on Easter Monday, with registration opening in January and parking at Winkelhart. There are also fun activities for children alongside the race.

name: Běh Terezským údolím
location: KVS Olomouc, Zákostelí, Náměšť na Hané, Czech Republic
description: Běh Terezským údolím is a race organized by SK RELAX Olomouc, held at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané. The 7.1 km course is an out-and-back route and almost flat, with climbs after the start and before the finish. The surface consists of field paths, asphalt, and gravel, offering a varied running experience. The race starts at 11:00 and is suitable for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course with climbs after the start and before the finish
Surface: field paths, asphalt, and gravel
7.1 km course at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané
additional: The race is organized by SK RELAX Olomouc. The contact person is Karel Pikal. The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners. The course is certified, and the race is listed in the official Český běh race calendar. In 2026, the race was part of the Hanácký běžecký pohár and the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje. The race information also lists a fitness run open to all ages.

10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid
description: The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is an annual running event with three distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl and 10 Mijl. The routes pass through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the beautiful countryside near the IJssel, with the start and finish at Wijkcentrum SIO. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organisation, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is a great challenge for runners who want to enjoy a varied course in a green setting.
course_highlights: Course through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the countryside near the IJssel
5 Mijl route of 8047 metres, starting at 17:00
10 Mijl route of 16093 metres, passing Harculo
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Lopers Company, Gasthuisplein 2, from Wednesday 9 April through Friday 11 April during opening hours, and on Saturday 12 April from 12:00 to 16:30 at Wijkcentrum SIO at Thorbeckelaan 2. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is not an official Atletiek Unie race. Minimum age is 14 for the 5 Mijl and 17 for the 10 Mijl. Race numbers must be worn visibly. The course is not suitable for wheelchair users or wheeler users. Distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl, 10 Mijl; registration opens in January; supports charities; location in Zwolle-Zuid.

name: 2Bruggenloop
description: The Ned Air 2Bruggenloop in Kampen is a lively running event that starts and finishes in the heart of the city. The routes cross two iconic bridges, the Stadsbrug and the Molenbrug, and offer beautiful views of the historic city skyline and the waterside natural scenery along the IJssel. The certified half marathon and 10-kilometre race are challenging, including a climb over the Molenbrug. There is a special Kidsrun through the city centre for young runners. After the finish, participants can unwind in the welcoming city centre during the Nacht van Kampen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the atmospheric Oudestraat in the heart of Kampen
Cross the impressive Stadsbrug with its golden wheels and the 600-metre-long Molenbrug, which stands 21 metres high
Beautiful views of the iconic city skyline and the waterside river scenery along the IJssel
additional: Starting corrals are assigned according to expected running time (Red, Purple, Yellow) to ensure a smooth flow. The start and finish area is at Van Heutszplein. Race numbers can be collected on the Friday evening before the race. Lockers are available for safely storing belongings. Merchandise is on sale, including hoodies, socks and shirts. The Kidsrun has separate start times: 13:00 for ages 4–9 and 13:15 for ages 10–12. After the finish, participants can unwind in the city centre during the Nacht van Kampen (band night). The event also offers a Kidsrun and Businessrun, and has a strong local reputation as one of the best running events in Kampen and the surrounding area.

name: Rondje Zegveld
description: Rondje Zegveld is a running event in the heart of Zegveld. Participants can choose from a 1.5 km Kids Run, a 5 km route or a 10 km route through the beautiful Groene Hart polder. Times are recorded electronically, and results are available online after the event. The event is open to all ages and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere. Late registration is also possible on the day, up to half an hour before the race starts.
course_highlights: A loop through the Groene Hart polder
A 1.5 km Kids Run through the centre of Zegveld
Water station after approximately 5 km on the 10 km route
additional: Late registration is possible on the day until 30 minutes before the race starts, while places are available. The awards ceremony is expected to take place around 15:15–15:30. Traffic measures and temporary road closures will be in place in and around the village during the event. First-aid personnel will be present along the route and at the finish. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes. The event on 3 April 2027 offers recreational and competitive runners alike a great opportunity to explore the area and take part in a local running event.

name: Woest Lochemsebergloop
description: The WOEST Lochemsebergloop is a friendly running event in Barchem, with distances for both children and adults. The kids’ run is specifically for children up to 16 years old and covers 1,000 metres, while adults can choose between a 5 km run or power walk and a 10 km run. The event takes place in a beautiful natural setting, with a focus on preserving nature. There is a drinks station and a litter zone along the route, and parking is well organised at Bon Aparte. The organisers are available to answer questions by email and aim to create a sporty, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances for children (1,000 m) and adults (5 km and 10 km)
Drinks station and litter zone along the route to help keep nature clean
Start and finish near the Bon Aparte car park in Barchem
additional: Parking and bicycle parking at the Bon Aparte car park. Toilets available at Bon Aparte. No changing or shower facilities at the start/finish. Drinks station and litter zone along the route. Start times by distance: kids’ run at 13:00 and 13:01, 5 km at 13:30, 10 km at 14:30. Trail run with various distances, located in Barchem, parking at Bon Aparte, no changing facilities or showers available.

name: Širokodolský kros
location: Obecní sál, Široký Důl, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
description: Širokodolský Cross-Country Run is a traditional off-road race held in the village of Široký Důl near Polička in the Pardubice Region. The event offers races for children and young people ranging from 60 metres to 4 km, as well as a 7 km main race with a mass start for men and women. The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks, with a climbing bonus on the first hill. Children can win prizes, while adults can receive cash prizes in their categories. The start and finish are by the municipal hall, creating a welcoming race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks
Climbing bonus on the first hill
Start and finish by the municipal hall in Široký Důl
additional: Children and young people start in successive age categories, with distances ranging from 60 m to 4 km. The 7 km main race has a mass start for men and women. Children receive prizes for the first three finishers in each category, while adults receive cash prizes for the first three in each category. The race starts by the municipal hall. The programme includes races for children and young people; the results for the 2026 edition list distances from 80 m to 7.8 km.
