The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organised by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place on 4 September 2026 around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. The event is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a programme including race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circuit around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on event day from 14:00 to 15:30. A walking group starts at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at four-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a musical act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC, near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. The event takes place in all weather. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Run on 4 September 2026; registration opens on 1 June 2026; takes place in all weather; parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: Straberger 1/3 Marathon
description: The Straberger 1/3 Marathon takes place on September 4, 2026, in Dormagen and offers races over 5 kilometers and 14.065 kilometers. The scenic route passes Kloster Knechtsteden and runs through the forest, making it ideal for beginners, experienced runners, and ambitious athletes. The event features samba and a festive atmosphere in the town center and is also suitable as a tune-up run for the Cologne Marathon. Children can take part in junior races and receive free running shirts and medals at the finish.
course_highlights: Scenic route past Kloster Knechtsteden
Run through the forest
Festive atmosphere and samba in Straberg town center
additional: Children up to U8 receive a free running shirt and a medal at the finish. Adults can order a breathable running shirt for 18 euros when registering and collect it with their race number on event day. The junior races take place at Linden-Kirch-Platz in the town center, with different lap lengths depending on age group. Parking is available nearby at Hubertus-Schützensaal and the sports ground. Scenic route, junior races, festive atmosphere, start and finish at Linden-Kirch-Platz, online registration, free for children up to U8, running shirt included

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: Der 23. Lehrter CityLauf findet am 4. September 2026 statt und ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in der Innenstadt von Lehrte. Die Läufe umfassen Distanzen von 2, 4 und 10 Kilometern, inklusive Bambini- und Schulläufen sowie einem Inklusionslauf über 2 Kilometer. Die Firmenwertung über 4 und 10 Kilometer wird erneut von der KURTULUS GRUPPE prämiert. Für eine tolle Atmosphäre sorgt musikalische Begleitung und ein abwechslungsreiches Rahmenprogramm mit Beteiligung der LSV-Abteilungen.

name: 6. Fränkischer Backyard Ultra
description: Der Fränkische Backyard Ultra ist ein einzigartiger Ultra-Lauf im Format "Backyard Ultra" mit einer 6,7 km langen Runde und ca. 90 Höhenmetern. Jede volle Stunde startet eine neue Runde, und der letzte Läufer, der eine Runde innerhalb des Zeitlimits von 60 Minuten beendet, gewinnt. Das Rennen findet in Heuchling statt und zeichnet sich durch seine offene Endzeit aus, da es so lange läuft, bis nur noch ein Läufer übrig bleibt. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit umfassender Verpflegung und einem besonderen Fokus auf Ausdauer und Gemeinschaft.

name: Dijkenloop
location: Beneden-Leeuwen, West Maas en Waal, Netherlands

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short running event taking place on September 5, 2026. There is also a hobby mountain bike race alongside the run. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an attractive opportunity to experience the autumn scenery of the Sauerland and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Short 0.4 km running course
Includes a hobby mountain bike race
Autumn woodland scenery in the Sauerland
additional: The event offers a varied course route, including a trail run, hill run, and mountain biking, with mostly changeable weather in the Sauerland.

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run “Laufen und Gutes tun” takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat loop courses through St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social causes, including pediatric outpatient palliative care, the Malteser Herzenswunsch ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. Alongside the runs, the event features an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo campaign to encourage participants’ social commitment.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs and materials can be collected on event day from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is available along the course, with tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. A charity tattoo campaign and DKMS registration will be available on site. Participation through membership is possible; donations support children’s hospices, DKMS, and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a Bambini run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in the picturesque Kurpark in Werl. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to a challenging 6.4 km course for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which encourages team spirit and fun. The varied course features numerous exciting obstacles that make the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is available up to 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race numbers use electronic timing via Racersult. An exclusive Kurparkcross shirt can be pre-ordered only until 30.06.2026. Spikes, barefoot running and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is permitted only for the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehl AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and ability levels. Starting at Wiehltal Stadium, the routes pass through the redesigned parks in the center of Wiehl and offer a scenic setting. Whether you run individually or as part of a team, the Summer Run invites you to get active, enjoy a sense of community, and have fun. The motto “We in Wiehl are sporty!” underscores Wiehl’s vibrant sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltal Stadium
Route through redesigned parks in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The run takes place on Saturday, 05 September 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact: Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Routes start at Wiehltal Stadium and offer a scenic setting. Registration available.

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Borkumer Meilenlauf und Nordic Walking
location: Borkum, Nordseeinsel Borkum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 01.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 20.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking takes place on 5 September 2026 on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied courses wind through the island’s scenic beaches and dunes, offering a suitable challenge for every aspiring runner, from the junior Pirate Run to the quarter marathon. The offshore climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, rounded off by an extensive programme for participants and their companions.
course_highlights: Courses through Borkum’s beaches and dunes
Offshore climate and fresh sea air
A variety of distances, from the Pirate Run to the quarter marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on site on event day up to 45 minutes before the start of the competition, for a late-entry fee of EUR 5.00, but without entitlement to the full package of services or a T-shirt. Refreshments on the course and at the finish, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck at Gezeitenland are included. Discounted ferry fares are also available on the event weekend. Courses along the promenade and beach; no age categories for Nordic Walking; refreshment stations on longer courses.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and provides ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course eligible for record lists through the Ederauen
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including for Nordic walking; donations support children's cancer aid; event in September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts on 5 September 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the sports field at Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at Inselschule
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a €15 fee applies if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the bicycle escort marking the end of the course. Parking is recommended, with the start area within walking distance. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: 4. Backyard Ultra Munich
description: Der Munich Backyard Ultra ist ein einzigartiges Laufevent in Oberschleißheim bei München, bei dem jede Stunde eine Runde von 6,7 km gelaufen wird. Das Besondere ist, dass immer dieselbe Strecke gelaufen wird und nur eine Person am Ende als Sieger:in hervorgeht. Das Event lebt von einer starken Community, bei der sich Läufer:innen, Helfer:innen und Zuschauer:innen gegenseitig unterstützen und gemeinsam eine besondere Atmosphäre schaffen. Für Sicherheit, Verpflegung und Komfort ist gesorgt, sodass sich die Teilnehmer:innen voll auf ihr Lauferlebnis konzentrieren können.

name: Palatina Backyard Ultra
description: Der Palatina Backyard Ultra ist ein einzigartiger Laufwettbewerb in Erfweiler, bei dem jede volle Stunde eine 6,7 km lange Runde gestartet wird. Die Teilnehmer laufen so lange, bis nur noch ein Läufer eine Runde innerhalb der Stunde schafft. Die Strecke führt vom Belmontplatz aus über Straßen, Felder und Waldwege mit etwa 100 Höhenmetern und bietet eine abwechslungsreiche Landschaft. Am Vortag findet ein gemütliches Treffen statt, und die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine offene Endzeit und eine familiäre Atmosphäre aus.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: Der 46. Internationale Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf des TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V. findet am 5. September 2026 statt. Die Veranstaltung ist ein traditioneller Volkslauf, der nach den Richtlinien der Deutschen Leichtathletik-Ordnung (DLO) gewertet wird und für alle Volkslaufabzeichen des DLV anerkannt ist. Es gibt Urkunden für alle Platzierungen, die online zum Download bereitgestellt werden, sowie eine Siegerehrung für die drei Erstplatzierten jeder Wertung. Zudem wird ein Sonderpreis für die stärkste gemeldete Gruppe vergeben. Die Teilnahmebedingungen und Haftungsbeschränkungen sind Voraussetzung für die Teilnahme.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: Der Volkslauf Eisbergen ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Porta Westfalica, die verschiedene Distanzen für Kinder und Erwachsene anbietet. Die Strecke führt rund um den Sportplatz Eisbergen und bietet mit 5,7 km für den Volkslauf und 17,7 km für die Langstrecke abwechslungsreiche Laufmöglichkeiten. Für das leibliche Wohl der Teilnehmer ist ebenfalls gesorgt, und die Veranstaltung ist Teil der Mühlenkreisserie. Die Strecke ist auch über Komoot einsehbar, was eine gute Vorbereitung ermöglicht.

name: Spargellauf - "Run den Damm"
description: Der Spargellauf „Run den Damm“ in Lampertheim ist ein beliebter Volkslauf mit 35-jähriger Tradition, der Läufer:innen aller Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus anspricht. Die Veranstaltung bietet Strecken über 5 km, 10 km und einen Halbmarathon auf einem flachen, gut markierten Rundkurs entlang des Altrheindamms mit Zieleinlauf im Adam-Günderoth-Stadion. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf sorgt eine lebendige Atmosphäre mit Zuschauern, Musik und einer After-Race-Party mit Live-DJ für ein unvergessliches Erlebnis. Der 10-km-Lauf ist zudem die Kreismeisterschaft des Kreises Bergstraße. Die Veranstaltung ist familienfreundlich und lädt sowohl ambitionierte Läufer als auch Laufanfänger und Walker herzlich ein.

name: Strassenlauf
description: Der Sandhofer Straßenlauf ist ein attraktiver 10-km-Rundkurs durch die Sandhofer Felder in Mannheim. Die Strecke ist offiziell vom DLV vermessen, flach, befestigt und größtenteils asphaltiert, was sie ideal für Leistungs- und Freizeitläufer macht. Neben dem Hauptlauf gibt es auch einen Schülerlauf über 1.200 Meter, der Jugendlichen Wettkampfluft schnuppern lässt. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcups 2026 und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Verpflegung, Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie einem Sanitätsdienst.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: Der VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der am 5. September 2026 zum 27. Mal stattfindet. Die Strecke führt über 19 Kilometer über den Dün und startet sowie endet im Vitalpark. Für jeden Teilnehmer wird ein Baum zur Aufforstung der heimischen Wälder gepflanzt, was den Lauf auch ökologisch besonders macht. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine herzliche Atmosphäre und lädt Läufer aller Leistungsstufen ein.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: Der Brockenlauf ist Deutschlands ältester Berglauf und findet seit 1927 jährlich in Ilsenburg im Harz statt. Die Hauptstrecke über 26,2 km führt mit 890 Höhenmetern auf den höchsten Berg Norddeutschlands, den Brocken, und bietet eine anspruchsvolle Herausforderung mit wechselhaftem Hochgebirgsklima am Gipfel. Die Strecke verläuft durch malerische Natur, historische Orte und bietet beeindruckende Ausblicke. Neben dem Hauptlauf gibt es weitere kürzere Strecken, die ebenfalls ein Naturerlebnis bieten. Die Veranstaltung ist offen für alle Läufer, unabhängig von einer Vereinsmitgliedschaft.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: Der Brokser Volkslauf findet am 5. September 2026 in Bruchhausen-Vilsen statt und bietet Läufen und Walking-Disziplinen für alle Altersgruppen. Die Veranstaltung umfasst Strecken von 400 m bis 20 km sowie Walking- und Nordic-Walking-Strecken. Bei jedem Wetter ausgetragen, erwartet die Teilnehmer ein buntes Rahmenprogramm mit Hüpfburg, Getränken, Kuchen und Bratwurst. Die Läufe starten am Schul- und Sportzentrum, und Kinder- sowie Jugendläufe werden mit Medaillen gewürdigt.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
description: Der Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb in Gremsdorf, der verschiedene Laufdistanzen für alle Altersgruppen anbietet. Die Veranstaltung umfasst Bambini-, Kinder-, Jugend-, Hobby- und Hauptläufe sowie Walking-Wettbewerbe. Die Strecken führen durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung von Gremsdorf und bieten sowohl für Freizeitläufer als auch für ambitionierte Sportler ein abwechslungsreiches Erlebnis. Der Lauf findet jährlich im Rahmen der Kerwa statt und ist ein beliebtes Event für die ganze Familie.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: Der 46. Internationale Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf lädt am 5. September 2026 alle Laufbegeisterten nach Poggenhagen ein. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufe über 5 km, 10 km und einen Halbmarathon an, die alle gemeinsam starten. Die Strecke führt landschaftlich reizvoll um Poggenhagen herum, vorbei am Fliegerhorst und bis zur Badeinsel in Steinhude. Für Kinder gibt es zudem Läufe über 450 und 850 Meter. Das Ziel aller Läufe ist der Sportpark des TSV Poggenhagen.

name: Run to the beat powered by Bang & Olufsen 2027
De Mijl van Mares Catch-up Run
Kustloop Vrouwenpolder

description: The Kustloop Vrouwenpolder is a challenging half marathon known as “Walchers mooiste” (Walcheren’s most beautiful). The approximately 21.1-kilometre route runs along Lake Veere and over the North Sea beach, with beautiful views and nature areas around Vrouwenpolder. Runners can also take part in shorter distances of 12 km and 6 km. The start is on Dorpsdijk, near the Pelgrimskerk, and refreshment stations are available approximately every 5 kilometres. Registration includes a T-shirt for walkers or a singlet for runners.
course_highlights: Approximately 9 km along Lake Veere
Route over the North Sea beach
Beautiful nature areas around Vrouwenpolder
additional: Walkers start at 10:30, and runners at 11:30. The prize-giving takes place as soon as a podium has been completed. Changing facilities are available in the gym a short walk from the start. Race numbers can be transferred or resold via the personal dashboard until 26 August 2026. A refreshment station is available approximately every 5 kilometres. The course runs along Lake Veere and the North Sea beach; registration includes a T-shirt or singlet, and changing facilities are available.

name: Veluwse Trailrun
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, open to individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Area in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026 at 11:15. Camping accommodation with full facilities is available. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers various age and team categories, with exchanges permitted in the transition area by the refreshment stand.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place every September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque setting of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is a program for children and an autograph session with athletes.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is intended both for experienced runners and for those who run for pleasure and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular refreshment stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný Up and Down is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organizers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: The Lupenice Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd year. The race offers a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, running entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: The Jenštejn Five is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also held, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. It is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque setting of Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill race that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by KOPEC, z.s., under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation, and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: 60. Festiwal Chodu to prestiżowe, międzynarodowe wydarzenie sportowe organizowane w portowym regionie Gdańska, które odbędzie się 5 września 2026 roku. Impreza gromadzi zawodników w różnych kategoriach wiekowych i poziomach zaawansowania, oferując konkurencje w chodzie na dystansach 10 km (kobiety i mężczyźni, w tym kategorie Open, U20, U18), 5 km i 3 km dla młodszych uczestników oraz Mistrzostwa Polski Masters na 5 km. W ramach festiwalu odbywają się także Mistrzostwa Polski U23 na 10 km oraz wydarzenia towarzyszące, takie jak Prolog „Chód z Listonoszem” i Bieg im. Obrońców Poczty Polskiej - Energa Cup. Organizator, Klub Lekkoatletyczny LECHIA Gdańsk, promuje aktywność fizyczną także wśród osób z niepełnosprawnościami, organizując wyścigi wózkarzy i zawody FrameRunning.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy to górskie zawody biegowe odbywające się w Sobieszowie, w sercu Karkonoszy. Festiwal oferuje różnorodne dystanse, od rodzinnego biegu edukacyjnego po wymagający ultramaraton na 102 km z ponad 5000 m przewyższenia. Trasy prowadzą malowniczymi, kamienistymi szlakami Karkonoskiego Parku Narodowego, oferując niepowtarzalne widoki i wyzwania dla biegaczy o różnym stopniu zaawansowania. Impreza ma charakter integracyjny i promuje bieganie jako sport drużynowy, a także edukację przyrodniczą.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny VII Srebrna Dziesiątka to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Olkuszbiega, Urząd Miasta i Gminy Olkusz oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olkuszu. Bieg główny na dystansie 10 km odbywa się na dwóch pętlach po 5 km, z pomiarem czasu chipowym i oznakowaniem co kilometr. Trasa prowadzi ulicami o nawierzchni asfaltowej i częściowo brukowej, start i meta znajdują się na Rynku w Olkuszu. Wydarzenie promuje aktywny tryb życia i bieganie jako formę rekreacji dla wszystkich grup wiekowych.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: Półmaraton Praski to coroczne wydarzenie biegowe odbywające się w Warszawie, które przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i doświadczonych biegaczy. Trasa półmaratonu prowadzi przez malownicze i historyczne części Pragi, oferując uczestnikom wyjątkowe widoki i atmosferę. Impreza ma charakter nocny, co dodaje jej unikalnego klimatu i atrakcyjności. Organizatorzy zapewniają profesjonalną obsługę, pomiar czasu oraz pakiety startowe z oficjalną koszulką.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: XLVI. Międzynarodowy Maraton Usedom to wyjątkowe wydarzenie biegowe, które prowadzi przez dwa kraje wzdłuż najdłuższej promenady nadmorskiej w Europie. Trasa o długości 42 km łączy polskie Świnoujście z niemieckim Wolgast, przebiegając przez historyczne kurorty i malownicze tereny leśne. Biegacze mogą cieszyć się różnorodnością nawierzchni oraz pięknymi widokami na Morze Bałtyckie, a także wyjątkową atmosferą wyspy Usedom.

description: The Bingen City Run is a long-standing running event in Bingen am Rhein, welcoming runners of all ages. It offers 10 km and 5 km races on courses measured by the DLV. The event takes place during the Bingen Winzerfest and attracts many spectators who enthusiastically follow the races and relays. Alongside the main races, there are also school and relay races, making for a diverse field of participants.
course_highlights: DLV-measured courses of 10,000 m and 5,000 m
Start and finish on Gerbhausstraße
Relay races with 5 × approx. 700 m laps
additional: Relay races are open to clubs, schools, and groups, with teams of 3 men / 2 women or 3 women / 2 men. All finishers receive medals, and the overall winners receive the City of Bingen coin. The fastest relay team receives a challenge trophy. Changing facilities are available at the Kulturzentrum am Freidhof. The time limit for the main races is 75 minutes. Online registration is open until 27.08.2025; late registration is possible on the day for a fee. Start and finish on Gerbhausstraße; start time is 11:00. Courses vary in length and difficulty.

name: Ehriker Stadtmauerlauf mit 2. Ehriker Burg Ramstein Lauf
description: The 6th Ehriker Stadtmauerlauf takes place on 30 August 2026 in Ehrang and offers runners a varied programme with different distances. New this year is the 10km Burg Ramstein Run, a shady scenic run that is part of the 4REGIO-CUP. The 5km route goes through the old village, with an atmospheric city-run feel over four laps. Children can take part in exciting youth races and Bambini races in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls. The event is DLV-certified and promises a sporting experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 10km shady scenic run, DLV-certified
5km city run over 4 laps through the old village, DLV-certified
Youth races and Bambini races in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls
additional: All races start in front of the stage at the Kyllkreisel. All races except the 10km race finish at Peter-Roth-Platz; the 10km race finishes shortly before the end of Ramsteiner Weg in Ehrik (Ehrang). New this year: the 10km Burg Ramstein Run, part of the 4REGIO-CUP. Children’s races feature thunderous applause, and Bambini races take place in the running tunnel between the fairground stalls. The event also includes family and youth races, as well as DLV-certified courses. Registration is via laufen.de, and the event is part of the 4REGIO-CUP, a regional running series.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon

price_tiers.distance: Halbmarathon (Einzel und Team), 5 km, 11 km, Mini-Marathon

description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The route passes the cathedral, runs through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda floodplains, and finishes in the stadium. The event is organised by volunteers from Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-planned course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other events, including 5 km and 11 km races and a mini marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The route passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
A run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda floodplains
Finish in Fulda’s city stadium
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approx. 09:40, 5 km at approx. 10:00, mini marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (lower secondary school). The routes for all events are clearly mapped and can be downloaded. The event is organised by volunteers, with comprehensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various events include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team and mini marathon; registration opens on 01.02.2026; check the terms and conditions and cancellation fees; numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city centre, along the Sonwik Marina and by the harbour. The marathon consists of four laps of 10.55 km, with a maritime atmosphere, and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same course, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km runs. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Four laps of 10.55 km through the city centre, Sonwik Marina and harbour
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: For registrations from 24.08.2026 onwards, race bibs will not be personalised, and medal engraving and shirts will not be offered. Race materials can be collected upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. Participation is limited to 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, prams and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race materials can be collected at Flensburg Galerie. Various race distances are available, including a marathon relay, children’s races and practice sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahme am DresdenHALF KidsRUN kostet 10 Euro.

description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that will pass through the heart of Dresden for the first time on September 6, 2026. The 21.1-kilometer course runs along the Elbe and past the city’s most beautiful landmarks, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience against a historic backdrop and with an international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are also other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden, along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for record lists. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Race packets will be distributed on September 4 and 5, 2026, at the World Trade Center Dresden. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive bobble hat. It is possible to transfer a race entry for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. The course is officially measured; participation is open to runners aged 16 and over; the time limit is 3 hours; merchandise and race-entry transfers are available; children’s races and events on the day before the race on September 5 are included.

name: Canyon Run Mühlheim
description: The Canyon Run in Mühlheim am Main is Hesse’s most beautiful forest run, taking runners through the Mühlheim quarries. It takes place on September 6, 2026. The event offers flat, officially measured courses, attractive prize money and prizes, and a unique atmosphere with live music in the finish area. Runners of all ages can choose from a range of distances, from the 400 m mini run to the half marathon, with excellent refreshments along the course. The race also supports social projects in the region, making the Canyon Run a special community experience.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured courses through the Mühlheim quarries and Mühlheim Forest
Half marathon with 80 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 50 metres, and 5 km with 20 metres
Start and finish at the Dietesheim sports grounds, with live music and excellent refreshments
additional: Net timing by transponder, provided by RST Volkslauf GmbH. Prize money and prizes for the fastest runners. Team competitions for companies, clubs, and schools. Professional photos in the finish area. Charity run raising donations for local social organisations. Races for families, kids, and teams; refreshments, prize money, photos, and community activities included.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity run for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend in September at the Buchenau athletics track. The event focuses on exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no ranking and no pressure to set personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and fosters a relaxed community atmosphere, with a warm-up program, music, food, a raffle, childcare, applause and participant certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at the Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event offers a community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a raffle, childcare and participant certificates. It takes place at the Buchenau athletics track in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Lauf mal wieder mit in Schmidt
description: TuS Schmidt warmly invites you to the 13th Lauf mal wieder mit in Schmidt on Sunday, September 7, 2025. The event features a challenging new half marathon course of 22 km with 480 metres of elevation gain through the beautiful Eifel landscape. It is open to runners of all ages and is part of the 2025 Eifel Cup and Regio-Aachen Cup. In addition to the half marathon, there are also 4 km and 10.8 km races, with the fastest female and male TuS Schmidt runners in each distance receiving awards.
course_highlights: Half marathon covering 22 km
480 metres of elevation gain in the Eifel
Races over 4 km, 10.8 km and the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a 2 p.m. cutoff (3 hours after the start). The races count toward the 2025 Eifel Cup and 2025 Regio-Aachen Cup. The fastest female and male TuS Schmidt runners in the 4 km, 10.8 km and half marathon distances are each recognized. The event takes place annually in September, with an 11 a.m. start and a 2 p.m. cutoff; it is also suitable for families and children, with special children's races and medals for all children.

name: Lembecker Galgenberglauf
description: The Lembecker Galgenberglauf is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 40 years, held in Hohe Mark Nature Park. The routes pass through gently hilly woodland and offer runners a special experience in nature. Various distances are offered, from a 400 m Bambini run to the 10 km main race, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable races for all age groups.
course_highlights: Routes pass through gently hilly woodland in Hohe Mark Nature Park
Running routes are entirely on forest paths, some of which are gravel
Gentle climbs along the route
additional: Start times are staggered by distance and age group from 09:30 to 10:40. Tea and water are available in the start and finish area, and breakfast is offered. No showers or changing rooms are available. The late entry fee for in-person registration on the day of the event is €3.00. Race on forest paths with gentle climbs; registration online or on the day of the event; no showers or changing rooms; tea, water and breakfast available.

name: New Balance KÖ MEILE 2026
price_range: kostenlos bis 28 Euro, je nach Kategorie und Meldedatum
description: The New Balance Kö Meile is a unique running event on Düsseldorf’s Königsallee, taking place on September 6, 2026. It offers runners of all abilities a running party with plenty of atmosphere, music, confetti, and a special setting in the heart of the city. The event includes various races over 5 km, the mile (1,609 m), and children’s and youth races. The course is officially measured, paved, and certified by World Athletics, making it eligible for rankings. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best or taking part in your first race, the shared running experience is what matters most.
course_highlights: Officially measured, paved circuit on Königsallee
Official World Ranking Competition with World Athletics certification
Atmosphere with a DJ truck, cheering zone, medal, and donuts
additional: The 5 km races are divided by target finish times to prevent lapping. A limited edition of event performance shirts is available to order only when registering. The Elite Mile for women and men, as well as the REHACARE Inclusion ½ Mile, are invitation-only races. Late registration is available until race day for an additional fee, subject to the participant limit. Officially measured, certified circuit; various race categories; personalized race bibs for registrations through August 30, 2026; event shirts available for purchase; race packs can be collected on September 4 and 5, 2026; shipping options available during registration.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Fun Run offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond areas, as well as historic places such as Schapen railway station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended mainly for children and young people, accompanied by their families. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route loops around the Riddagshausen ponds and passes through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and historic Schapen railway station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. There is a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V. The event takes place in September 2026 and includes various running and walking distances, as well as activities such as a warm-up, childcare and massages.

name: Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The 20th Sparkassen City Run in Wachtendonk takes place on September 6, 2026, transforming the municipality into a lively running arena. The event welcomes all ages and ability levels, from ambitious runners and recreational joggers to families. The races start at 2:00 p.m. at Friedensplatz, accompanied by an exhilarating atmosphere, a varied supporting program, and dedicated volunteers. The run offers outstanding athletic performances and personal achievements in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of races for all ages and ability levels
Start and finish at Friedensplatz in Wachtendonk
An exhilarating atmosphere along the course and a varied supporting program
additional: Registration is easy via the registration button on the website. The event is being held under the leadership and organization of the Municipality of Wachtendonk for the first time. A varied supporting program and dedicated volunteers help create a special atmosphere. Races for all ages and ability levels, online registration, supporting program, at Friedensplatz

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Kinder & Jugendliche bis einschl. Jahrgang 2008

description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-standing running event taking place on September 6, 2026, in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, young people, and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team race, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loop courses through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop course through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Race packs (bib numbers including transponders) will be distributed at the VfL-Sportzentrum Fahltskamp on 04.09.2026 from 09:00-19:00 and on 05.09.2026 from 09:00-16:00. Late entries are possible online until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €5.00. The team classification is based on 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available; bib number pickup is on September 4 and 5 at the VfL-Sportzentrum; late entries are subject to a fee; the start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Wallmeroder Bahnhofslauf/ 34. Nat. Straßenlauf
description: The Wallmerod Bahnhof Run is a traditional road race in Wallmerod, Germany, and will be held for the 34th time in 2026. Organized by the local sports club TuS Wallmerod, the event features two distances: a short 400-meter run and a half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. The race starts early in the morning and is firmly established in the German road-racing calendar. The course is themed around the town’s railway station and is aimed primarily at local runners and club athletes.
course_highlights: Road race with a railway-station theme
Distances: 400 m and 21.1 km (half marathon)
Traditional event with more than 30 years of history
additional: Results from previous years are available online, with an archive dating back to the early 2000s. Participants receive certificates and can access individual result searches. September weather is typically mild, with daytime temperatures of around 19 °C and nighttime temperatures of 10 °C. It is usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place in typical September weather in Wallmerod. Participants receive certificates and can access their results, with a focus on local runners.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: Brunsberglauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: Der Parchener Fiener-Cross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf im Jerichower Land, der als Teil der ELBE-OHRE-CUP Laufserie im Norden Sachsen-Anhalts stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung zieht jährlich zahlreiche Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen an und bietet mit dem Heidel-Team-Cup und der Familienwertung zusätzliche Wettbewerbe. Der Lauf findet an der Klapperhalle in der Parkstraße in Parchen statt und ist bekannt für seine abwechslungsreiche Crossstrecke. Die Veranstaltung fördert den Laufsport in der Region und verbindet sportlichen Wettkampf mit Gemeinschaftserlebnis.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
description: Der 15. Brunsberglauf am 6. September 2026 in Buchholz/Holm-Seppensen bietet Läufern ein abwechslungsreiches Programm mit Hauptläufen über 11,7 km, einem Halbmarathon sowie einem 5 km Familienlauf. Die Strecken führen durch Wald und blühende Heide mit Highlights wie der Höllenschlucht, dem Brunsberg, dem Mühlenteich und dem Zwergentunnel. Zusätzlich gibt es vier Kinderläufe für verschiedene Altersstufen. Im Zielbereich erwartet die ganze Familie ein attraktives Rahmenprogramm. Der Brunsberglauf steht unter dem Motto "Laufen und Gutes tun" und unterstützt gemeinnützige Organisationen in der Region.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
description: Der Schoninger Volkslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Solling, die jährlich vom SC Schoningen 04 ausgerichtet wird. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern verschiedener Alters- und Leistungsklassen die Möglichkeit, auf abwechslungsreichen Strecken durch die schöne Landschaft rund um Schoningen zu laufen. Der Lauf zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und eine starke Gemeinschaft aus, die den Sport und das Miteinander fördert. Jedes Jahr nehmen zahlreiche Läufer teil, um sich sportlich zu messen und gemeinsam ein tolles Laufevent zu erleben.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: Der CURREX Alsterlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Straßenlauf in Hamburg, der auf einer flachen, verkehrsfreien Rundstrecke um die Binnen- und Außenalster stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine einzigartige Start- und Zielatmosphäre in der Hamburger Innenstadt und zählt zu den größten 10-Kilometer-Straßenläufen Europas. Neben dem Hauptlauf über 10 km gibt es auch Wettbewerbe über 5 km, einen Schülerlauf sowie die R5K-Tour für Nachwuchsläufer. Die Strecken sind offiziell vermessen und bestens für schnelle Zeiten geeignet.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
description: Der 38. Breunaer Malsburglauf findet am 6. September 2026 statt und ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna. Der Lauf bietet eine attraktive Strecke in der schönen Natur rund um Breuna und richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersklassen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Breuna e.V. organisiert und ist Teil des Nordhessencups. Die Anmeldung erfolgt über die Plattform RaceResult.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: Der Tuchmacher Stadtlauf in Bramsche ist ein beliebter Lauf mit mehreren Strecken, der jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer anzieht. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und eine abwechslungsreiche Streckenführung durch die Innenstadt aus. Besonders der 10-km-Hauptlauf zieht leistungsstarke Athleten an, während der Schülerlauf mit großer Beteiligung für viel Stimmung sorgt. Die Bramscher Rumläufer organisieren den Lauf mit viel Engagement und Unterstützung durch lokale Schulen und Sponsoren.

name: Bahndammlauf
description: Der Buchholzer Bahndammlauf ist eine abwechslungsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die Natur und Genuss verbindet. Die Strecke führt vom Stadion über den Bahndamm durch die Ortsteile Wahl und Wallau bis zum Franziskuskreuz, mit einem anspruchsvollen Steigungsstück zum Mückensee, dem höchsten Punkt der Strecke. Danach geht es überwiegend bergab oder eben weiter nach Asbach-Walgenbach mit mehreren Getränkestationen. Die Veranstaltung findet am Sportplatz des SV Buchholz 05 statt und bietet neben dem Lauf ein umfangreiches Kuchenbuffet sowie herzhaftes Essen von den Grillhexen. Die Teilnahme unterstützt den Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: Der 38. Breunaer Malsburglauf findet am 6. September 2026 statt und ist eine etablierte Laufveranstaltung in Breuna. Der Lauf führt durch den Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna und bietet eine attraktive Strecke für Läufer. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Breuna e.V. organisiert und richtet sich an Läufer verschiedener Alters- und Leistungsklassen. Die Anmeldung erfolgt über die Plattform RaceResult.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: Der Gölitztallauf ist ein jährlich stattfindender Lauf in Marktgölitz, der am 6. September 2026 seine 44. Auflage feiert. Der Lauf ist in vier verschiedene Strecken unterteilt, darunter eine Kinderstrecke über 1 km. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre aus und bietet Ehrungen in verschiedenen Altersklassen. Die Siegerehrungen finden zeitnah nach den Läufen statt, um die Wartezeit für die Teilnehmer gering zu halten.

name: Hochgratlauf
description: Der Hochgratlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Berglauf auf den höchsten Gipfel der Allgäuer Nagelfluhkette. Die Strecke führt über 12,8 Kilometer mit 714 Metern Höhenunterschied und einer Gipfelhöhe von 1.834 Metern. Neben dem Hauptlauf gibt es einen Nachwuchs-Berglauf für die Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2015 auf einer verkürzten Strecke. Der Lauf findet jährlich statt und zieht Läuferinnen und Läufer sowie Zuschauer aus Nah und Fern an, die die Herausforderung und die landschaftliche Schönheit der Allgäuer Alpen genießen.

name: Lautrer Lebenslauf
organizer: Mama / Papa hat Krebs Kaiserslautern e.V.
description: Der Lautrer Lebenslauf ist ein Benefizlauf in Kaiserslautern, der Solidarität mit krebskranken Menschen und deren Familien zeigt. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufe über 1 km für Kinder sowie 5 km und 10 km Waldstrecken für Läufer, Walker und Nordic Walker. Der gesamte Erlös unterstützt den Förderverein „Mama/Papa hat Krebs“ Kaiserslautern e.V. und ermöglicht kostenfreie Hilfsangebote für Kinder krebskranker Eltern oder Geschwister. 2026 wird erstmals eine technische Zeiterfassung mit Trackern eingesetzt, um die Veranstaltung noch professioneller zu gestalten.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: Der CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb mit offiziell vermessenen, flachen und asphaltierten Rundkursen entlang der Außenalster und auf dem Ballindamm. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Distanzen, darunter 10 km, 5 km und Schülerläufe, und richtet sich an Läufer:innen verschiedener Altersklassen. Die Läufe werden verkehrsfrei und sicher durch Polizei und Ordner begleitet. Im Rahmen des Alsterlaufs werden auch die Hamburger Meisterschaften über 10 km Straße ausgetragen.

name: SaarschleifenLand-Lauf
description: Der SaarschleifenLand-Lauf in Merzig bietet ein vielfältiges Laufprogramm für alle Altersklassen mit Strecken von 250 m bis zum Halbmarathon. Besonders spannend ist der Hauptlauf, bei dem die Teilnehmer während des Rennens entscheiden können, ob sie 15 km oder den Halbmarathon (21,1 km) laufen möchten. Die Strecke führt entlang des malerischen Saarleinpfads mit schönen Panoramablicken und integriert die Stadtmeisterschaft im Halbmarathon. Die Veranstaltung ist familienfreundlich mit Bambini- und Schülerläufen und bietet Duschen sowie Kleideraufbewahrung in der Stadthalle Merzig.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: Der Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf findet im Rahmen des Heimat- und Soldatenfestes in Stadtallendorf statt und wird vom TSV Stadtallendorf in Zusammenarbeit mit der Bundeswehr organisiert. Die Laufstrecke ist ein Rundkurs durch den Heinz-Lang-Park und das angrenzende Stadion. Angeboten werden Wettkämpfe für verschiedene Leistungsklassen, darunter ein Jedermann-Lauf über 5 Kilometer und ein Hauptlauf über 10 Kilometer. Im Anschluss folgen Wettbewerbe für Jugend und Kinder. Der Lauf zieht zahlreiche Athleten an und bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in einer freundlichen und festlichen Atmosphäre.

name: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum
description: Der Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum 2026 ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der durch die Innenstadt von Bochum führt. Die Strecke umfasst eine Einführungsrunde und drei große Runden mit etwa 150 Höhenmetern, was den Lauf abwechslungsreich und herausfordernd macht. Neben dem Halbmarathon gibt es auch Staffeln, einen 10-km-Lauf, einen 5-km-Lauf, einen Schülerlauf und einen Bambini-Lauf. Die Veranstaltung bietet zudem ein umfangreiches Rahmenprogramm und einen Vorbereitungslauftreff ab Mai 2026.

name: Staffellauf der MBB-SG Augsburg
description: Der 41. Augsburger Staffellauf der MBB SG Augsburg findet am 6. September 2026 im Siebentischwald in Augsburg statt. Die Veranstaltung bietet einen Staffelmarathon mit drei Läufern, die jeweils eine Runde von 7.032,5 Metern laufen, sowie einen Einzelstart über die Halbmarathondistanz von 21,1 Kilometern. Die Strecke ist asphaltiert, flach, schnell und verläuft größtenteils im Wald, was ideale Bedingungen für Läufer aller Leistungsstufen schafft. Zusätzlich gibt es einen Hobby-Lauf über eine Runde von etwa 7 Kilometern, der besonders für Anfänger geeignet ist. Die Strecke ist gut markiert und als Wendepunktstrecke konzipiert.

name: Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: Der Wardenburger Sommerlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf von Läufern für Läufer, der in Wardenburg an der IGS am Everkamp stattfindet. Angeboten werden verschiedene Streckenlängen ab 5 Kilometern, darunter ein 5 km Jedermannslauf, ein 10 km öffentlicher Lauf sowie ein 10-Meilen-Lauf. Die Läufe zeichnen sich durch eine abwechslungsreiche Strecke aus, bei der insbesondere die Teilung der 10 km und 10 Meilen Läufe am Tillysee eine wichtige Orientierung darstellt. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf eine faire und gut organisierte Durchführung mit Zeitmessung per Chip und bietet auch spezielle Läufe für Kinder an.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: Der Lauf in Dörverden ist ein vielseitiges Laufevent, das für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen geeignet ist. Die vermessenen Strecken reichen von 1,8 km für Gehen, Laufen und Walken bis hin zum Hauptlauf über 10 km, der aus zwei Runden à 5 km besteht. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre und fördert den Gemeinschaftssport in der Region Niedersachsen. Die Läufe starten gestaffelt ab 10:00 Uhr, sodass jeder Teilnehmer seinen passenden Wettbewerb findet.

name: Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon
description: Der Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon findet am 6. September 2026 in der malerischen Landschaft der Fränkischen Schweiz statt. Die Strecke führt von der Neideck bis zum Walberla und passiert dabei idyllische Dörfer, Burgen und Felsen. Die autofreie Bundesstraße sorgt für optimale Laufbedingungen. Zehntausende Zuschauer und ein vielfältiges Rahmenprogramm verleihen dem Event einen Volksfestcharakter. Die Jubiläumsausgabe lädt Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Leistungsstufen herzlich ein, teilzunehmen.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: Der GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven ist ein jährlich stattfindender Marathon in Bremerhaven, der seit 2005 ausgetragen wird. Die Veranstaltung umfasst neben dem Marathon auch einen Halbmarathon und einen 10-km-Lauf. Die Strecke ist ein flacher Rundkurs mit Start und Ziel vor der Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, der durch die Innenstadt und die Havenwelten führt. Die Läufer erleben eine attraktive Strecke mit vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten und einer einmaligen Kulisse entlang des Wassers und der Hafenanlagen. Veranstalter ist die Eventagentur Execute Sports Events, die für eine professionelle Organisation sorgt.

name: Gå og løb med Støt Brysterne 5. sep. 2027
Ørestad Half Marathon & 10K
description: Flat half marathon and 10K by the sea on Kalvebod Fælled in Copenhagen. AIMS-certified course, starting and finishing at Naturcenter Amager, 5 minutes from Vestamager Metro. The course is flat, with only around 7 metres of elevation gain, and runs along the coast and through the nature reserve. In 2026, 801 runners from 50 nations finished. The entry fee includes chip timing, a medal and a digital diploma. There is room for around 1,000 runners.
additional: Half marathon starts at 10:00, 10K starts at 10:25. Start and finish: Naturcenter Amager, Granatvej 3, 2770 Kastrup. Price: half marathon DKK 495 (DKK 595 from 22/8-2027), 10K DKK 395 (DKK 495 from 22/8-2027).

name: Rondje Oude IJsselstreek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten per team bedragen € 60,00. Inschrijven kan t/m vrijdag 3 september 2027.

description: The Rondje Oude IJsselstreek is an annual relay race organized by athletics club Atletico’73, in which teams of seven runners cover distances between 4 and 7 kilometers. The start and finish are at the Atletico'73 athletics track in Gendringen. The route passes through a beautiful green setting and several villages in the municipality of Oude IJsselstreek. Participants enjoy the event as a fun, sporty activity to share with their teammates.
course_highlights: 7 stages of between 4 and 7 kilometers through a green setting
Routes through the villages of Ulft, Silvolde, Westendorp, Sinderen and Voorst
A mix of paved and unpaved roads and paths, sometimes with loose sand
additional: Teams consist of 7 people, with at least 1 woman and 1 man. There are two start waves, with the slower wave starting first. Bonus and penalty minutes are awarded based on the team’s gender mix and speed. Prizes are awarded to the fastest team, the last team, and teams that finish in specific places. Cycling routes are available to reach the relay points without crossing the running routes. Untrained runners and participants under 14 are advised not to take part. 7 distances between 4 and 7 km, course on paved and unpaved roads, start and finish at the Atletico’73 Gendringen athletics track

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands, amid the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying distances and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which adds to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, offering beautiful views of the surrounding countryside and historic landmarks.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on 6 September 2026 in the centre of Ostrava, on Masaryk Square, and offers races for different ability levels, including a minimarathon, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The event is for both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also includes a charity MiniMarathon. In addition to the races, a rich programme of activities will bring sport and culture to the city centre.

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Run is a challenging cross-country race held on Babí hora near Chodov. It follows forest paths with several tough climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with various distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main event. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes, with cash awards also offered in the main category.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov Helps Through Running is a charity race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, while the best runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun quiz with prizes, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: The Run Between the Bridges is a charity sporting event organized by the Athelas Home Hospice and the Friends of the Stone Bridge in Písek Association. Reviving the tradition of the original race, it is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a variety of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on 6 September 2026 in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course climbs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Krkonoše Cup in Hill Running. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges runners’ endurance and their ability to run on technical mountain terrain. Registration is available on site, and the race is intended for runners looking for a challenge in nature.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: 14 Tyski Półmaraton to bieg na dystansie półmaratonu (21,0975 km) z atestem PZLA, odbywający się ulicami miasta Tychy oraz wokół jeziora Paprocańskiego. Start, meta oraz miasteczko biegowe zlokalizowane są przy Stadionie Lekkoatletycznym w Tychach. Impreza promuje aktywny tryb życia i sportową atmosferę miasta, oferując także liczne atrakcje towarzyszące, takie jak biegi dla dzieci, masaże i pokazy sportowe. Trasa została zmodyfikowana w 2022 roku, aby zmniejszyć liczbę podbiegów, co czyni ją bardziej przyjazną dla uczestników. Bieg odbywa się pod honorowym patronatem Prezydenta Miasta Tychy i cieszy się rosnącą popularnością od 2012 roku.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: 26. edycja Toyota Eko Półmaraton Wałbrzych to jedno z najważniejszych wydarzeń biegowych w regionie i w kraju, które przyciąga biegaczy z całej Polski. Po zeszłorocznym sukcesie organizacyjnym i rekordowej frekwencji, impreza ponownie potwierdza swoją silną pozycję na sportowej mapie Polski. Trasa półmaratonu została bardzo dobrze oceniona przez uczestników, a wyjątkowa atmosfera tworzona przez wałbrzyskich kibiców dodaje wydarzeniu niepowtarzalnego charakteru. Zapraszamy serdecznie zarówno do udziału, jak i do kibicowania.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet to coroczny bieg organizowany w Bielsku-Białej, który w 2026 roku odbędzie się 6 września na Stadionie Miejskim. Wydarzenie jest poświęcone pamięci Ewy Szymanek-Płaskiej, naczelniczki Wydziału Edukacji i Sportu w Urzędzie Miejskim w Bielsku-Białej. Tegoroczna edycja biegu wspiera dzieci w spektrum autyzmu, a zapisy rozpoczną się 10 kwietnia 2026 roku o godzinie 10:00. Honorowy patronat nad biegiem objął Prezydent Bielska-Białej, Jarosław Klimaszewski.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła to bieg na 5 km odbywający się w Bukownicy, Mazowieckie. To doskonała okazja dla biegaczy na różnych poziomach zaawansowania, aby sprawdzić swoją formę na łatwej, asfaltowej trasie. Organizatorzy zachęcają do przygotowania się z pomocą planów treningowych dopasowanych do indywidualnego poziomu, oferując wsparcie ekspertów. Wydarzenie ma charakter przyjazny i motywujący, idealny dla osób chcących poprawić kondycję i cieszyć się bieganiem.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race run mostly along the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Nature Trail. The route starts at the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and on-site refreshments and storage for personal belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top three finishers in each category receive diplomas.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, featuring a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, field and forest paths. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is suitable for the general public; adults pay an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to participate.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: The Witzenmann Opava Mile is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its presenting partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event held on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 8:00 p.m. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km lap. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the finish. Participants compete at their own risk and can use public transport and parking nearby.

name: Bergisch Gladbacher Stadtlauf
organizer: SV Blau-Weiß Hand e.V., Stadt Bergisch Gladbach
price_range: Hauptlauf: 11-23 Euro, Erlebnislauf: 9-13 Euro, Gruppenrabatte verfügbar
description: The Bergisch Gladbach City Run is a long-standing running event that has taken place annually since 1996. On September 11, 2026, around 1,000 running enthusiasts will start at 6:30 p.m. on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the car-free city center. The event includes an untimed fun run and a main race with rankings in various age groups. The event is accompanied by a colorful program of music, food, and drinks, adding to the atmosphere of the city and culture festival.
course_highlights: Run through the car-free city center of Bergisch Gladbach
Start and finish on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the city center
Traditional opening event of the city and culture festival
additional: Late registration for both races is available on September 12, 2025, from 4 p.m. The fun run is untimed and has no age-group categories. The main race includes rankings for all age groups, from birth year 2014 onward, in accordance with the 2025 German Athletics Regulations. Certificates for all participants are available online. The awards ceremony is at around 9 p.m. Special awards go to the largest registered group and the youngest and oldest participants. Distances: 3 km and 9 km; online registration; timing with a MikaTag transponder; program includes music and food.

name: Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Bergneustadt, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bergneustadt, Germany, held on a Friday after nightfall. The program offers several running and walking options, including a flat 3.7 km course, a 5.4 km relay, a 5.4 km run, and a 10 km run. All races start and finish at the same locations, making the event family-friendly and easy to follow. Children’s and youth competitions round out the program, making the evening appealing to local clubs, young runners, walkers, relay teams, and adults looking for a short but intensive evening run.
course_highlights: Flat 3.7 km course as a gentler option
Hilly 5.4 km and 10 km courses
Shared start and finish area for all races
additional: The event takes place on Friday evening after nightfall. It is designed to be compact, making it easy for families and supporters to follow. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Family-friendly; children’s and youth competitions; September event with typical weather of around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, and 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten
price_range: 40 Euro (5 km und 10 km), 25 Euro (Jahrgang 2010-2013 5 km), plus Pfand
description: The 31st Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten takes place on September 11, 2026, in Xanten and offers races over 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is an established running event in the city of Xanten and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. The course runs through the city and offers varied scenery.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Course through the city of Xanten
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and cloudy skies
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Races in Moers, Sonsbeck, Neukirchen-Vluyn, and Xanten; registration until March 2026; T-shirt included; rankings based on gun times

name: Ipsheimer Weinberglauf
location: Ipsheim, Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
