tiers.description: REWE Engel Genuss Walk: 15 EUR BKK VerbundPlus Halbmarathon: Teilnahmegebühr 28 EUR. Incl. der Option, eines der Funktionsshirts für nur 3 EUR zu erwerben – gültig für die ersten 40 Anmeldungen.

description: The Biberach Genießerlauf offers a scenic running event in the heart of Upper Swabia, with the start and finish on the historic Biberach Market Square. Participants can choose between the BKK VerbundPlus Half Marathon, the 2 x 8 km Kreissparkasse Biberach Relay, and the 6 km REWE Engel Genuss Walk. The route follows paved paths as well as firm forest and field paths, with wonderful views, including the Bussen, Upper Swabia’s holy mountain, and, in good weather, even the Alps. Excellent refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, where finishers can also look forward to a glass of Prosecco.
course_highlights: Half marathon with a flat start, a climb from km 5, and wonderful views of the Allgäu
2 x 8 km relay with the baton handover in Biberach city centre
6 km Genuss Walk along beautiful paths in the Wolfental, with or without poles
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday, 17 October, from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Stadthalle Biberach. Generous refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, including a glass of Prosecco for finishers. Technical shirts can be purchased online or when collecting race bibs (while stocks last). On-site late registration is possible if places are available. Race entries can be transferred to another person free of charge. Age categories follow DLV guidelines. Certificates and prizes are awarded for age-group winners and the fastest participants/teams. Course on asphalt and forest paths; refreshments along the route and at the finish; registration online and on site; no shirts for corporate registrations; race bib collection at the Stadthalle.

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambach Autumn Forest Run is a traditional race in Niederzier-Hambach, held every year in autumn. In autumnal weather, runners enjoy the beautiful atmosphere and the forest’s vibrant colors. Around 200 participants take part across various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a friendly, community-minded and athletic atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Run through the autumn forest amid colorful foliage
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
A traditional event with a friendly club atmosphere
additional: The event attracts around 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online, with certificates available to print. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. The website provides no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers or registration options. Forest trail; online registration possible; start and finish at the Sophienhöhe parking lot; event in October 2026

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie Cochem-Zell 2026 in Bremm
description: The 39th Cochem-Zell Cross-Country Series race in Bremm is an exciting running event in the picturesque Moselle wine region. The cross-country routes, ranging from 1 km to 8 km, follow uneven, natural trails through mud, meadows, and woodland. These challenging routes require sure footing, strength, and coordination, offering runners an authentic cross-country experience away from paved roads. The event is ideal for anyone looking to test their winter fitness and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Run through the Moselle wine region
Rugged, uneven trails through mud, meadows, and woodland
Distances from 1 km to 8 km, with challenging sections
additional: The cross-country series is part of the popular running events in the Cochem-Zell district. The course is a test of winter fitness and offers a genuine cross-country feel on natural trails. Cross-country running, 1 km to 8 km, uneven trails, trail running in a wine region, registration presumably required

name: Naturpark Schönbuchlauf Hildrizhausen
description: The Naturpark Schönbuchlauf in Hildrizhausen is a traditional autumn race with a long history, taking place for the 51st time on October 18, 2026. The event offers a range of distances from 5 km to 50 km, including the popular 25 km Naturpark Schönbuchlauf and the challenging 50 km Schönbuch Ultra. The races take runners through the scenic Schönbuch region, an ideal running area with well-marked courses. The event caters to runners of all abilities, from beginners to experienced ultrarunners, and also offers children’s races. The running group of TSV Hildrizhausen organizes the race with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Schönbuch Nature Park
Well-marked routes, with spray-painted arrows and directional signs at critical points
A variety of distances from 5 km to 50 km, including an ultradistance
additional: The event headquarters is at Schönbuchhalle, which opens at 08:00 on race day. The awards ceremonies also take place there. The routes are marked throughout with spray-painted arrows, with directional signs at critical points. Children’s races (approx. 1,000 m and 2.5 km) and a 5 km junior course are available. The event is part of the Schönbuch Cup, with rankings for various races. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, 50 km; online registration available; race on October 18, 2026; parking and public transport available; changing rooms, showers, and refreshments at Schönbuchhalle.

name: Rottweiler Volksbanklauf 2026
description: The 13th Rottweil Volksbank Run is a varied running event in Rottweil, offering both children’s and youth races and a challenging main race over 10.12 km on a rolling circuit. The course consists of 1.3 km laps with 108 m of elevation gain, featuring repeated hills that challenge runners. There are also relay races over 10.1 km for teams of 3 to 8 participants. The event is more of a local running day, with a varied program for all age groups.
course_highlights: Main race over 10.12 km on a rolling circuit
1.3 km lap with 108 m of elevation gain
Relay races for teams of 3 to 8 runners
additional: Children’s and youth races over 300 m, 600 m and 1.3 km are part of the program. Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C high, 6 °C low, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Races for children and young people; local event; varied course with 108 m of elevation gain per lap.

name: Salacher Löwenlauf
description: The Salacher Löwenlauf is a running and Nordic walking event in Salach, Germany, taking place on October 18, 2026. The courses cover 500 metres for children, 2 kilometres for teenagers, 6 kilometres for fitness runners and Nordic walkers, and 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The course is undulating but well suited to beginners, and all races finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle. The event is organised by TSG Salach, which also highlights the connection to the Stauferland region in the Nordic walking race.
course_highlights: Undulating course profile, not a flat sprint
Finish on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle
A range of distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Start times are planned around midday. There are dedicated races for children (500 m Bambini Löwenlauf) and teenagers (2 km Jugend-Löwenlauf). The event also includes a 6 km Nordic walking race. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with occasional rain and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes Nordic walking and is open to all age groups. It is recommended that participants check the details with the organiser before registering.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a schoolchildren’s run, a 5 km everyone’s race, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the run a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late registration is possible until approximately 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; certificates are awarded for the 5 km everyone’s race and 5 km walking, and trophies for the three fastest runners in the 10 km main race, as well as certificates for all participants. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Weißenhorner Altstadtlauf
description: The Weißenhorn Old Town Run is a traditional race held every year in October in the historic old town of Weißenhorn. The event is organized by TSV Weißenhorn and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race is known for its varied course through the picturesque old town and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. Enjoyment of running and community are at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Weißenhorn
Varied terrain with views of the town
Traditional event in October
additional: The race is organized by TSV Weißenhorn, which also offers other athletics training groups and events. The athletics department meets regularly for training, and the Old Town Run is an annual highlight in October. The event takes place at the TSV hall and in the old town. It is held every year, with various races for all age groups. Registration is usually through Race Result, and the results are publicly available. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course goes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all abilities and also offers a public race series with additional competitions during the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, with water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers in the sports hall at Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Level 1 of the Schlosshöfe car park
additional: Race packs will be handed out on October 11 from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, road closures in the city centre, finisher medals, online registration available

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: Der Müggelsee-Halbmarathon ist ein landschaftlich reizvoller Lauf im Südosten Berlins, der komplett um den Großen Müggelsee führt. Die Veranstaltung bietet drei Streckenlängen: Halbmarathon, 10 Kilometer und 5 Kilometer, die jeweils als Pendelstrecken oder Rundkurs gestaltet sind. Die Strecke verläuft unter anderem durch den historischen Spreetunnel und bietet eine idyllische Kulisse mit Blick auf den größten Berliner See und die umliegenden Müggelberge. Der Lauf ist für alle Läufer geeignet, die Bestzeiten anstreben oder einfach die Gemeinschaft und Natur genießen möchten. Start und Ziel befinden sich an der Müggelseeperle, und der Lauf findet am 18. Oktober 2026 statt.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: Der Almetal-Marathon 2026 findet am 18. Oktober statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern eine landschaftlich reizvolle Strecke von Büren-Ringelstein bis zum Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Neben der klassischen Marathondistanz gibt es zwei Halbmarathon-Varianten sowie einen Staffelwettbewerb über vier Teilstrecken. Die Veranstaltung ist geprägt von ehrenamtlichem Engagement zahlreicher Sportvereine und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre sowie ein beeindruckendes Naturerlebnis im Almetal.

name: Ditzinger Keltenlauf
description: Der Keltenlauf in Ditzingen-Hirschlanden ist ein vielseitiger Lauf für Jung und Alt mit Distanzen von 12 km, 6 km, 1,5 km und 800 m. Die Strecke führt durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Region Strohgäu und passiert bedeutende archäologische Denkmäler wie den Keltenkrieger und das keltische Frauengrab. Die Läufe finden am Sport- und Freizeitzentrum Seehansen statt und bieten sowohl für Erwachsene als auch für Schüler und Bambinis passende Wettbewerbe. Die Veranstaltung findet bei jedem Wetter statt und wird mit moderner RFID-Zeitnahme durchgeführt.

name: Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf
description: Der Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf ist ein traditionsreicher Gruppenlauf, der in Hof startet und die Teilnehmer auf dem Webersteig zum Döbraberg, dem höchsten Punkt des Frankenwaldes, führt. Die Veranstaltung findet im Oktober statt und bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 8,5 km, 14,5 km und 23 km sowie 8,5 km Walking- und Nordic-Walking-Routen. Die kürzeren Läufe für Erwachsene werden ohne Zeitnahme durchgeführt, wobei der Fokus auf dem gemeinsamen Erreichen des Gipfels liegt. Die Strecke ist hügelig und anspruchsvoll, mit einem strukturierten Ablauf, bei dem Pacemaker das Tempo vorgeben und Überholen nicht erlaubt ist. Der Lauf wurde 1968 zu Ehren von Dr. Heinz Laubmann, dem Gründer der IfL-Clubs, ins Leben gerufen.

name: Gosheimer Lemberglauf
description: Der Gosheimer Lemberglauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Gosheim, Baden-Württemberg, der Teil des Silberdistel-Albcups ist. Die Strecke startet an der Kreissparkasse im Ortszentrum und führt zum Ziel auf dem Lemberg, mit einem Kleidertransport möglich. Der Lauf bietet verschiedene Distanzen, darunter Schüler- und Bambiniläufe sowie weitere Wettbewerbe, die zur Gesamt- und Vereinswertung des Cups zählen. Für alle Teilnehmer gibt es Urkunden, und die besten Läufer erhalten Sachpreise. Die Veranstaltung ist familienfreundlich und lädt Läufer aller Altersklassen ein.

name: Kauferinger Stauseelauf
description: Der Kauferinger Stauseelauf ist eine Laufveranstaltung in Kaufering, die verschiedene Distanzen anbietet, darunter Halbmarathon sowie kürzere Strecken von 0,4 km, 0,8 km und 8,2 km. Die Veranstaltung zieht Läufer aus der Region an und bietet eine abwechslungsreiche Strecke rund um den Stausee. Die Atmosphäre ist familiär und eignet sich für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus. Ergebnisse und Fotos vergangener Jahre sind auf der Webseite verfügbar, was die Tradition und Beliebtheit des Laufs unterstreicht.

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: Der Müngstener Brückenlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Solingen, der durch malerische Landschaften führt. Die Strecke beginnt auf dem schmalen Schäfchenweg und bietet einen letzten Anstieg vor dem Ziel, vorbei an Wiesen und Feldern. Der Lauf wird vom Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. organisiert und zieht Läufer aus der Region an.

name: Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim
description: Der Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim ist eine lokale Straßenlaufveranstaltung in Kleinostheim, Deutschland, die an der Maingauhalle auf der Ludwigstraße stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSG Kleinostheim organisiert und bietet neben Kinder- und Jugendläufen auch 5 km und 10 km Läufe für Erwachsene an. Die Strecke für Erwachsene ist flach und führt als Hin- und Rückkurs, wobei alle Läufe an der Maingauhalle enden. Die Veranstaltung findet bereits in der 15. Auflage statt und ist im deutschen Leichtathletikkalender gelistet, was ihre Bedeutung im organisierten Vereinslauf unterstreicht.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on Sunday, 18 October 2026, and is known for its fast, flat course and rich historical background. The start and finish are at the iconic Olympic Stadium, with a route along the Amstel, past stately townhouses and windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. The event attracts thousands of runners every year and offers an unforgettable experience, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium
Course along the Amstel with beautiful views of townhouses and windmills
Through the city’s green heart: Vondelpark
additional: The marathon is a World Athletics Platinum Label race with a fast course. An official Mizuno race shirt can be ordered, and an international pasta party is held for participants. The 7.5K run takes place on Saturday, finishing at the Olympic Stadium. There are also special business runs and kids’ runs. Globalrunning.com offers travel packages including an entry place, accommodation, and transport. The event also includes a Kids Run, Heroes Run, and charity runs; travel packages are available; registrations and ticket resales are handled through the official websites.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Winter Cross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country running series in the wooded De Dennen area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race, on 18 October 2026, offers several distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km and 0.75 km, with the start at Nattevlakweg. The route follows scenic, winding forest paths and is suitable for both young runners and adults. The race is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. The start times are 10:30 for children aged 12 and under and 10:50 for all other participants.
course_highlights: Wooded De Dennen area with winding paths
The longest distance on 18 October is approximately 14.7 km, divided into 3 laps
Sheltered start location near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration opens at 9:45 at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Cash payment, preferably with the exact amount, is appreciated; otherwise, a payment request will be sent. Children aged 12 and under run 750 metres and start at 10:30; all other distances start at 10:50. The cross is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. 2026–2027 season, several distances, courses from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45, location: 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: Bunkercross
description: De Bunkercross in Olst is een unieke en pittige crossloop die de 17e editie viert als sportieve opening van het Sallands Cross Circuit. Het volledig onverharde parcours voert je over historische commandobunkers en door de bossen van landgoed De Haere, een gebied vol natuur en geschiedenis. De loop trekt een breed deelnemersveld, van regionale toppers tot fanatieke recreanten, en biedt een uitdagende en sfeervolle start van het crossseizoen. Startnummers worden uitgereikt in het imposante Kasteel De Haere, waar na afloop ook gezellig nagepraat kan worden.

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: De Zeezichtloop Petten vindt plaats op 18 oktober 2026 met start en finish op Plein 1945 in het hart van Petten. De loop biedt diverse afstanden voor hardlopers en wandelaars, waaronder een ontspannen wandeling van 10 of 15 kilometer, een uitdagende 5 km hardlooproute die tweemaal wordt gelopen, en een feestelijke Kidsrun voor de jongste deelnemers. Het parcours voert langs de dorpskern, de dijk met prachtig zeezicht, duin en bos, waarbij pittige klimmetjes en mul zand zijn vermeden voor een toegankelijker parcours. De dag wordt afgesloten met prijsuitreikingen en de uitreiking van de Erik ten Velden bokaal aan de snelste Pettemer op de 10 km.

name: Mjitte Run
description: De Mjitte Run in Boazum is een hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op 18 oktober 2026. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 5 km, 10 km en 15 km, deels over mooie landelijke wegen en paden. Het evenement biedt een gezellige sfeer voor zowel recreatieve als fanatieke lopers en vindt plaats tussen 11:30 en 18:00 uur. De Mjitte Run is een jaarlijks terugkerend evenement dat de lokale gemeenschap samenbrengt.

name: De Kievitloop Oktober 2026
location: Bergen op Zoom, North Brabant, Netherlands

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of Český ráj, featuring a varied and undulating course that winds among sandstone rocks, forest paths, and white-sand trails. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and technical runners. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, which is less than an hour from Prague. Race day also includes children’s races and an accompanying programme, including a children’s area.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, featuring a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course runs over mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic race for all participants.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” race in Zlín is a traditional running event that gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Mládeže Stadium, and the route takes runners through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several distances—25 km, 16 km, 8 km, and relays—and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at the Olympia Park complex near the rope course in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.

name: Běh na Žaltman
description: The Běh na Žaltman is an open hill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Hill Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge amid beautiful natural surroundings. The route follows demanding terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all abilities. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes athletes and fans of hill running alike.

name: Běh okolo Rané
description: The Run Around Raná is a race held in the surroundings of Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy running in natural surroundings with picturesque views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: Półmaraton Gliwicki to wydarzenie biegowe organizowane od 2014 roku, które przez 12 lat stało się ważnym punktem na mapie biegowej Polski. Bieg odbywa się na trasie rozpoczynającej się i kończącej w Hali Widowiskowo-Sportowej PreZero Arena w Gliwicach. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, limit czasu na pokonanie trasy oraz wsparcie wolontariuszy i służb miejskich. W 2026 roku bieg kończy się, a organizację przejmuje miasto Gliwice, kontynuując tradycję tego wydarzenia.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: 52. Maraton Dębno to najstarszy i jeden z najszybszych maratonów w Polsce, odbywający się 18 października 2026 roku. Trasa o długości 42,195 km, atestowana przez PZLA, prowadzi ulicami Dębna i okolic, sprzyjając uzyskiwaniu życiówek. Impreza ma bogatą tradycję sięgającą 1966 roku i przyciąga zarówno amatorów, jak i profesjonalnych biegaczy z kraju i zagranicy. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na profesjonalną organizację, liczne punkty odżywcze oraz gorący doping kibiców. Maraton jest także okazją do integracji środowiska biegowego i świętem sportu dla całych rodzin.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: WARTKO!... Bez Gaszowice to coroczny bieg uliczny na dystansie 10 km organizowany przez Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach. Impreza przyciąga miłośników aktywnego spędzania czasu i promuje sportowy styl życia w lokalnej społeczności. Bieg odbywa się w malowniczej okolicy Gaszowic, oferując uczestnikom możliwość rywalizacji i wspólnej zabawy. Wydarzenie ma charakter otwarty i przyjazny dla biegaczy na różnym poziomie zaawansowania.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with all routes offering a hilly course rather than a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it offers a more intimate running experience than large city events. The organiser, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a supervised cloakroom and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of a flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Maximum of 1,400 participants. No on-the-day registration is available. Facilities include public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, an AED, a supervised cloakroom and massage. Typical October weather is cool and crisp, with an average temperature of 14°C, a minimum of 6°C and 40mm of rainfall. Make sure to register in advance; late registrations are not possible. Facilities such as parking, changing rooms, first aid and massage are available. The event is easily accessible by public transport and offers a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Herfstloop Twente is one of the oldest running events in the east of the Netherlands, organised since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes runners through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon routes return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginner runners and young people. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural area near Rutbeek
Original courses for the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon races
The 2-mile distance is suitable for beginner and returning runners, as well as young people
additional: The start and finish are on the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is open from age 11. The organising committee consists of 7 people, with more than 50 volunteers on the day. Participants give the Herfstloop an average score of 8. Registration is via the website. Facilities include free parking, with a medal available for €1.50. The event takes place in the natural surroundings of Enschede.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is a trail half marathon through the beautiful surroundings of Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified 21.0975 km course along forest paths, a nature trail, and tracks with minimal asphalt and no significant climbs. The event also includes 10 km races, a relay, and children’s races, all with convenient facilities and refreshments along the course. It is ideal for nature lovers and trail runners who want to discover the forest’s beautiful spots and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Skihütte Bad Wildbad
location: Skihütte Bad Wildbad, 75323 Bad Wildbad, Germany

name: Loučení s oválem
description: Farewell to the Track is a traditional race organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Sports Club. It has been held annually since 2000 as the final track race of the season. Originally intended only for young athletes, it added adult categories in 2014, with distances of 1500 m for men and 800 m for women. After a break from 2017 to 2019, the race returned in 2020 with 800 m events for young athletes and 3000 m for adults. The race takes place at Na Příkopě 1159 in Frýdek-Místek and is a popular event among the region’s athletics community.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup on 17 October 2026 offers runners of all ages and ability levels suitable distances in the beautiful region of Vaihingen an der Enz. The event includes a range of races, from Bambini runs to challenging trail routes of up to 24 kilometres and up to 700 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy the varied landscape of asphalt, gravel paths and trails. The Laufcup is also part of a regional support programme that helps schools and promotes community spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of routes from 550 m to 24 km, with up to 700 metres of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter, with good public transport connections
additional: Online registration closes on 8 October 2026 at 23:59. Late registration is available online from 9 to 17 October 2026 for an additional fee, subject to places being available. All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school support project run by the Alison and Peter Klein Stiftung, which covers registration fees and donates €5 to each participant’s school for every finisher. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter on St. Veith-Straße. Parking is permitted only in designated areas; travel by public transport is recommended. Several race distances, trail and asphalt routes, detailed route information available

name: Altendorf-Ersdorfer Obstmeilenlauf
description: The Altendorf-Ersdorf Orchard Mile Run is a traditional fun run that has taken place every year since 1995 on the last Saturday in October. The event offers races for all ages and ability levels, including the Little Orchard Mile (5.3 km), the Big Orchard Mile (9.6 km) and the Mega Mile (16 km). The course runs through the picturesque orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf and is especially popular for the fresh apples at the finish and the fruit baskets awarded to the winners. There are also special children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m. The run is a sociable event that combines running with nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course through the orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf
Three main distances: 5.3 km, 9.6 km and 16 km
Children’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event is always held on the last Saturday in October. The runners meet regularly for training in the Altendorf-Ersdorf Forest. The winners receive generously filled fruit baskets, and fresh apples are handed out at the finish. The event includes distances of 400 m, 1 km, 3.3 miles, 6 miles and 10 miles. It is a family-friendly event with children’s and toddler races, held annually in October in Meckenheim.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a long-standing event taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, it features a revised course that follows two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a multi-sport club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run course
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
A long-standing race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was revised for 2025. The event is part of TSG Helberhausen’s diverse sports program; the club has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary edition features a special course layout, with all runners completing the routes in reverse. The event offers a range of competitions, including children’s races and Nordic walking, on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Internationaler Halbmarathon, 56. Internationaler Volkslauf
description: The International Half Marathon and International Volkslauf in Herzogenrath are established road races organized by DJK Jung Siegfried Herzogenrath. The event includes a 21.1 km half marathon and a 5 km Volkslauf, designed as a community race for all age groups. With the 46th edition of the half marathon and the 56th edition of the Volkslauf, the event has a long tradition and is listed in the laufen.de race calendar. The organizer is a multi-sport club that offers the community other sports and fitness activities in addition to running.
course_highlights: Road race in Herzogenrath
Officially measured half-marathon course (21.1 km)
5 km Volkslauf as a community race
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, mostly cloudy, average precipitation 40 mm. The event is integrated into local club activities and, alongside the race distances, offers a community atmosphere that encourages both sporting challenges and socializing.

name: NELLINGER Kirbe-Lauf
description: The Nellinger Kirbe Run is a long-standing recreational sporting event in Ostfildern-Nellingen, held annually in October. The main race covers approximately 7.3 km; there are also schoolchildren’s and Bambini races for younger participants. The event is organized by Turnverein Nellingen 1893 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a sporting challenge. The course runs through the town and is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 p.m. to ensure a safe race.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 7.3 km (5 laps)
Schoolchildren’s race: approx. 1.45 km (1 lap)
Bambini race: approx. 400 m for children under 8
additional: The course is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 p.m. Parking is limited, so the use of public transport is recommended. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners, prizes to the top three finishers in each category, and team trophies for the schoolchildren’s race, main race, and company competition. The award ceremonies take place at 3:10 p.m., 4:20 p.m., and 4:40 p.m. The event also includes local awards, medical support from the DRK Ostfildern, and nearby parking. Registration is open from 31 August to 20 October 2026. Participation is intended only for those with adequate physical fitness.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 during golden October. The 50-kilometer course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain crosses the Three Imperial Mountains—Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen—through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, other events include the Alb Ultra at approx. 60 km, the 37 km Alb-Trail, a 25 km race, a 10 km run and walk, and a children’s race. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied program including a talk, briefing and pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,100 meters of elevation gain across the Three Imperial Mountains: Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes
A range of distances, from the children’s race to the 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start for all races (except the Alb-Trail) is on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Event center at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing using a transponder in the race number (no ChampionChip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by local and special buses is available to participants with a race number. Friday evening program includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward the meal). Loop course across the Imperial Mountains, aid stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, race number with RFID transponder

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchner Raiffeisen Cross-Country Run is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. The start and finish are at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross-Country Series and offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including short courses from 0.65 km to 1.3 km and longer races of 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging and hilly rather than flat, making even the short distances strenuous. Separate races for children and teenagers, as well as a special 6.6 km race for men, round out the programme.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, not a flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Centre
Various distances for children, teenagers and adults
additional: Results, photos and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical October weather: around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course distances, separate categories for children and teenagers, not a flat road race, and a sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Erzgebirge Cross is a long-standing running event in the Erzgebirge, organised by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country course through the Erzgebirge. It is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and is a regular fixture in the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Erzgebirge
A range of courses for children, young people, adults and masters
Organised by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: The registration deadline is 2 November 2025. Entries should be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is given as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes various categories and age groups, with possible official results for rankings. October weather is typically cool, with temperatures around 14°C; rain is possible.

name: Lauf zur Crosslauf Serie im Kreis Bernkastel-Wittlich
description: The cross-country series in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district is a long-standing running event consisting of three races in Breit, Wintrich and Bengel. The series offers courses for various age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 200 to 7,400 metres. The races take place on varied cross-country courses through the sports grounds and surrounding terrain. Participants who take part in all three races receive a gift, and the series winners are honoured with certificates, prizes and cash awards for the middle- and long-distance events.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 200 m to 7,400 m for all age groups
Cross-country courses around the sports grounds in Breit, with the start and finish area by the festival hall
Showers and changing rooms available in the clubhouse at the sports grounds
additional: Late entries are accepted on site until 1 hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €2.00. The event takes place at the sports grounds in Breit. Showers and changing rooms are available in the clubhouse at the sports grounds. After all three races, the series winners receive certificates and prizes; the overall middle- and long-distance winners also receive cash awards. Several race distances are offered, including children’s and adult categories, with medals, certificates and prizes. The event takes place in typical October weather, with temperatures around 14°C.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
price_range: 20-40 EUR pro Veranstaltung, kostenlos für Kinder unter 15 Jahren, zusätzlich 10 EUR bei Anmeldung vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: U18 und U20 – 20 EUR pro Veranstaltung

description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an internationally recognized race walking meeting taking place on 24 October 2026 at Weinauparkstadion in Zittau. The competitions cover various distances from 1 km to the marathon, held on an officially measured and certified 1-km loop on flat asphalt. The event is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver level and offers both elite and public races for various age groups. The organizers emphasize professional timekeeping, medical care and compliance with international competition rules.
course_highlights: Flat 1 km asphalt loop in Weinaupark, Zittau
Officially measured and certified course
Penalty Zone used for longer distances (5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon)
additional: Children up to age 15 can take part for free. Late entries are possible until 21 October 2026 for an additional fee of 20 EUR. Accreditation and race-number collection take place on 23 October from 16:00 to 18:00 and on 24 October from 8:00 onwards in the start and finish area. The marathon time limit is 4:45 hours. Doping controls are conducted in accordance with World Athletics and WADA. The race takes place on a flat asphalt course in Weinaupark in Zittau, with various categories for youth, adults and masters. Judging seminars are also held, and international competition rules are applied.

name: Alb Marathon
description: The Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has taken place every year since 1991 during golden October. The route covers 50 kilometres with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen, through breathtaking scenery. Alongside the classic marathon, other races include the Alb-Trail (37 km), the Alb-Ultra (approx. 60 km), as well as shorter distances and relay races suitable for runners of all ability levels. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family, with a varied programme including a talk, briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race.
course_highlights: 50 km route with 1,100 metres of elevation gain over the Three Imperial Mountains of Hohenstaufen, Rechberg and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural scenery and landscapes on the Swabian Jura
A variety of races, from the Bambini run to the 60 km Alb-Ultra
additional: All races start on Schwerzerallee, level with the Großsporthalle. Race headquarters are at the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing uses a transponder in the race bib (no Champion Chip). A medal is included for races over 25 km; a medal for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport by regular and special buses is available for participants with a race bib. The programme on Friday evening includes a talk, briefing and pasta party (€7 contribution toward costs). Several race distances are offered, including the 50 km Ultra, 37 km Trail, 25 km, 10 km and relay; the event includes a trail briefing, pasta party and family-friendly activities.

name: 100km Staffellauf um den Pokal der Uni Tübingen
B.U.T.XxX - BURGBERNHEIM ULTRA TRAIL
description: Der B.U.T.XxX - Burgbernheim Ultra Trail ist ein anspruchsvoller Ultratrail-Lauf in der malerischen Landschaft von Burgbernheim, Bayern. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, die Natur und die abwechslungsreiche Strecke mit anspruchsvollen Anstiegen zu erleben. Der Lauf ist eine Herausforderung für erfahrene Trailrunner und fördert die Gemeinschaft unter den Teilnehmern. Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Burgbernheim organisiert und findet jährlich statt.

name: Lauf der Crossserie des BLV-Kreises Ansbach
KNÆK CANCER LØBET AABYBRO 2026 & ØLAND AFD.
location: Aabybro, Jammerbugt Municipality, North Jutland, Denmark

KRC Van Elderen Stadshagenrun 2026

description: The Veluwe Winter Competition 2026-2027 is an accessible mountain bike competition held on a variety of challenging and varied courses in the Veluwe region, including Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede/Lunteren and Zutphen. Races are timed and consist of multiple laps, making them suitable for experienced recreational mountain bikers. The competition comprises up to 9 races and is open to participants with a KNWU or NTFU licence, with enjoyment and sportsmanship at its heart.
course_highlights: Varied courses in and around the Veluwe
Timed races with 5 to 10 laps
An easier B-line is available on difficult sections
additional: The races begin with a draw to determine the first starting rows at Nunspeet and Soest; from Oldebroek onwards, riders are lined up according to the current standings. The starting order of categories 8 & 9 and 10 & 11 alternates from race to race. A transponder is required and is attached to the handlebar plate. Races are timed rather than distance-based and last 5 to 10 laps. The best 5 results count towards the overall standings. A day licence is no longer required; participation without a licence is at your own risk. Registration is via inschrijven.nl and is also possible on-site, with mobile payment or cash. The competition includes several events in autumn and winter at locations such as Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede / Lunteren and Zutphen. Registration is handled via email, and detailed route information is available. Live results are displayed on the website.

name: All4running Crosscircuit
description: The All4running Crosscircuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held in North Holland at various locations, including Hoorn, Wieringerwerf, Den Helder and Spierdijk. The races vary in distance and are suitable for a range of age categories, from juniors to seniors. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races. The circuit offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere, with a ranking and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Varied courses in wooded areas and sports park settings
A range of distances for juniors and adults, from 1,000 metres to 10,000 metres
Races at various locations in North Holland, including Risdammerhout and Dijkgatbos
additional: You can register for the entire circuit or for an individual race. Participants must return their chip after the race to avoid additional costs. A points system determines the final ranking, with the best four results counting and bonus points awarded for taking part in all five races. Found items are kept for 14 days by the organising club. Final prize categories are divided by age and gender. Cross-country races in Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk; registration available on race day; return your chip and prizes awarded to top finishers.

name: Battle of the Zekskes
description: The Battle of the Zekskes is the very first Cornhole tournament in Velden, an accessible and sociable game in which teams of at least four people throw beanbags at a wooden board to score points. The event takes place on 18 October 2025 and is organized by Sportvereniging Velden. Alongside the sporting competition, an evening celebration is also planned, making it a fun combination of competition and socializing for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Accessible cornhole game with beanbags and wooden boards
Teams of at least 4 people
Held at Theo Lommen Sportpark in Velden
additional: The minimum age to participate is 16. An evening celebration is planned after the tournament. Teams consist of at least 4 people. Cornhole game, teams of at least 4 people, evening celebration after the tournament

name: Nacht van de Nacht wandeling
description: The Night of the Night walk in Breda is a special experience where you walk in silence through the darkness and enjoy the natural nighttime surroundings. During the walk, you can experience the peace and quiet and, weather permitting, a beautiful starry sky. The activity highlights the importance of darkness and combating light pollution, and is suitable for a broad audience who enjoy nature and quiet.
course_highlights: Walk in complete darkness
Experience silence and nature at night
Possibility of seeing stars in clear skies
additional: The Night of the Night includes various activities such as walks, boat trips, stargazing and lectures. Some activities are wheelchair-friendly and suitable for children. Participants can sign up via an online form. The campaign aims to raise awareness of light pollution and the importance of darkness for nature and health. Various activities include stargazing, walks, boat trips and lectures, focusing on darkness and the nighttime experience.

name: Tálínská desítka
location: Tálín, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Tálín, now being held for the 23rd year. The race is open to the general public and offers an opportunity for athletes of all ages, including recreational runners. The event supports community life and sporting activities in the municipality and its surroundings. The race is scheduled to start on October 24, 2026, at 12:00 in Tálín.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
Held in the municipality of Tálín in the South Bohemian Region
Suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels
additional: The race is part of the municipality of Tálín’s sporting events, which support sporting activities and community life. The event is also suitable for athletes with disabilities. It is organized by the municipality of Tálín in cooperation with the Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek sports clubs. The race is 9.5 km long; results and participants from 2026. It is traditionally held in autumn.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: Třebíč Marathon 2026 invites you to run through the picturesque lanes of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can enjoy the atmosphere of its UNESCO sites, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. Choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10K, or children’s races—offering a great sporting experience for everyone. Look forward to refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, followed by a chance to relax and enjoy the AfterRun party, the perfect way to end the day. Come and enjoy an unforgettable day full of movement and a great atmosphere in the heart of Třebíč.
course_highlights: Picturesque lanes in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO sites, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a great atmosphere
additional: The entry fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. The organiser notes that race packs are available in limited quantities and may not be available for on-site registration. Online registration and payment are available only until 20 October 2026 at 24:00; after that, registration is available only on site. Races include the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and children’s races; registration is open until 20 October 2026; entry fees range from CZK 100 to CZK 1,400, depending on the category and registration date.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
location: Cholín u Slapské přehrady, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 550 Kč / 33 km, 600 Kč / 47 km, 700 Kč / 61 km (při včasné registraci), vyšší ceny po 30.09.2025

description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race in the picturesque surroundings of the Slapy Reservoir in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, crossing rugged terrain with significant elevation gain. The race is suited to experienced runners looking to test their abilities in nature and earn points toward their UTMB Index. The race hub is in the village of Cholín; start times vary by course and take place on Saturday. The organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with 2,300 m of ascent and 2,400 m of descent
47 km course with 1,850 m of ascent and descent
Scenic routes around the Slapy Reservoir with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 by the Živohošť Bridge. The race cutoff is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 Kč per night in a bed, or on a sleeping mat in the common room. Registration changes are free until 12 October 2025; after that, a 100 Kč fee applies. The terrain includes trails, off-trail sections, rocky areas, and climbs. The race offers accommodation, set start times and cutoffs, and contributes to the UTMB Index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc and held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race features a challenging 9 km off-road course that tests runners’ endurance and strength. The main category starts at 10:15, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletics Federation. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country course on off-road terrain
Start and finish at the AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suited to endurance runners
additional: The race is held at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run is an off-road running event set in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13 and 22 kilometres, running mostly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The route is gently undulating, with a few hills, and is suitable for recreational runners and those who prefer a relaxed pace and want to enjoy the beautiful countryside and colourful autumn scenery. The course is well marked, and the stream crossings are shallow and easy to get across. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Off-road route running mostly through forests and meadows, away from paved roads
The longest route is 22 km, with three interconnected loops and a moderate elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run over fallen leaves, with a well-marked course and shallow stream crossings
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and trail ribbons. The stream crossings are shallow and can be crossed with dry feet using a footbridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running; registration details are not specified; an autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories, including a half marathon, a 10K, and shorter distances for children and young people. It also includes canicross categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest surroundings of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family, including beginner runners.
course_highlights: GELOREN and MIZUNO forest routes of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Canicross distances from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Aid stations along the course and at the finish, chip timing, and a unique finisher’s medal
additional: The entry fee includes a unique finisher’s medal, a Speedcup cup, chip timing, drinks, refreshments, a race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment can be borrowed by prior arrangement. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Aid stations along the course and at the finish, prize money for elite canicross competitors. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December, the event includes charity activities and the option to borrow equipment.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful natural surroundings within sight of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course through a picturesque valley on both natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in peaceful, scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with picturesque views and scenic sections
A race near the city of Prague, with the atmosphere of a nature park
additional: The course is accessible as part of the race; no wave divisions or capacity limits are specified. After registering, participants will receive payment instructions by email. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which also includes races in Průhonice Park, Divoká Šárka and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks in Prague, online registration, pre-race runs and events featuring KEEN shoe testing

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Běhej Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area in the Beskydy Mountains. The race gives athletes of all ages and fitness levels the chance to test themselves in beautiful countryside, with views of the hills of Wallachia. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come and enjoy a run in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area
Running in the Beskydy countryside among the hills of Wallachia
Traditional race with a long history, part of the series since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers events in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers are MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The race director can be reached at +420 602 275 790. The race routes follow paved roads and forest trails, with the option to relax in thermal pools. Registration opens at 8:00, and races start at 9:30. Course maps are available on mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race and mixed team race, and welcomes every runner, whether a beginner or an experienced athlete. The atmosphere is professional, with world-class elite runners and extensive facilities including refreshments, music and sports shopping. The course is one loop, with the start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
The chance to run alongside the world’s elite runners
additional: Race entry can also be purchased on-site in cash or by QR code during registration. The race pack includes an original Macron technical T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments during and after the race, a large expo, and free taping and physiotherapy care. The race takes place on a one-loop course, with partial traffic restrictions in effect during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The event includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. It is held with the support of the City of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 2.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné TROJIC je stanoveno na 2.700,- Kč

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a challenging 50 km ultramarathon that follows the valley of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh through Lázek to the river’s source on Buková hora. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, including Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve, where the race also finishes. The total elevation change is 698 metres of descent and 1,369 metres of ascent. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora, where runners can rest and refresh themselves after finishing. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge beyond a standard marathon but who do not want to take on an extreme 100 km mountain course.
course_highlights: The route follows the course of the Moravská Sázava River
Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with 1,369 m of ascent
additional: Participants can hand in their own refreshment bags to be transported to the aid stations. Support is available only at aid stations. Check-in is from 10:00 at the start in the Zábřeh skatepark. Aid stations also serve as relay handover points. Soup with pasta is provided at the finish. Results are recorded both electronically and manually; the relay baton is a GPS tracker with online tracking. Participants can hand in labelled bags for the aid stations at the start. Personal support is allowed only at aid stations.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country and trail race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice. It offers courses of varying lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, over gently rolling terrain with a natural surface, finishing on an asphalt straight. The race is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. and is accessible only on foot from nearby stops. The entry fee is voluntary, enabling broad participation by runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Gently rolling course with a natural surface
Asphalt finishing straight
Loops around the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice
additional: The start and race office are at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir, accessible only on foot from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The entry fee is voluntary. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; they can only be reached on foot. Information about the 2026 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including sections alongside the reservoir and the castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Intermediate checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12:00; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened course to the finish. Race number includes a baggage tag and a raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/changes possible on 24.10.2026 from 13:00 to 14:30, with a late registration fee of 5 euros. Registration opens on 01.08.2026. Race numbers include chips; age-group rankings, team and special rankings. No refunds. Limits apply to the company and family runs and Special Olympics. Participation includes shipping of the entry fee.

name: Olympiaberg-Cross München mit Deutschem Cross Cup
organizer: Förderverein Leichtathletik & Events München e. V.
price_range: Männer/Frauen 18 Euro, Jugend 8 Euro, Kinder 8 Euro, Barfußlauf 8 Euro
description: The Olympiaberg Cross Munich is a challenging cross-country race in Munich’s historic Olympic Park, taking place on October 25, 2026. The course follows a loop of approximately 1,100 metres, with several notable climbs and obstacles such as straw-bale sections. The race is part of the German Cross Cup and offers age-group and team classifications. Elite runners can win cash prizes, and all participants receive a certificate through an online service.
course_highlights: Approximately 1,100-metre loop with several marked uphill sections
Four numbered straw-bale sections as technical obstacles
Start and finish in the central area of Olympiaberg in Munich’s Olympic Park
additional: Online registration is possible until 60 minutes before the respective start. DLV start authorisation requires the DLV start-pass number and DLV regional association to be provided. All participants can use an online service to print their certificates. Separate age-group and team classifications are available (U12 to U18). Barefoot runners receive a special gift. The course features climbs and obstacles (straw bales) and is a challenging, hilly route. Online registration. Start and finish in Munich’s Olympic Park.

name: Ottensteiner Wottellauf
