tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ben je geen Vroege Vogel, dan is het inschrijfgeld vanaf 1 oktober: 10km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 16.00

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Schrijf je vòòr 1 oktober in tegen de prijzen van 2025: 5 km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 8.00

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ben je geen Vroege Vogel, dan is het inschrijfgeld vanaf 1 oktober: 5 km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 9.00

description: The Boerenkoolloop in Warmenhuizen is a friendly race and fun run over 5 and 10 km, starting and finishing on the AV NOVA athletics track. The course passes through the villages of Tuitjenhorn, Eenigenburg and Warmenhuizen, partly along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk, where the wind can be a challenging factor. After the event, every participant receives a bag of ingredients for a delicious boerenkool mash, sponsored by Koninklijke VEZET. There is also a 1.2 km youth run and an approximately 11 km walk, which follows a partly reversed route. The venue offers spacious changing rooms, hot showers and additional amenities for comfort.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the AV NOVA athletics track
Route along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk
Views of the surrounding landscape, with the wind as a challenging factor
additional: Race numbers are mailed out and should arrive around 30 October. They can also be collected from the Harenkarspelhal next to AV NOVA up to 15 minutes before the start. Spacious changing rooms and hot showers are available. After the event, everyone receives a boerenkool package with sausage, potatoes and herbs. Parking is available at AV NOVA and at Bejo Zaden BV, approximately 800 metres away. The walking event starts between 8:30 and 9:30; participants must reach the finish by 12:30 to receive the boerenkool package. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl until 25 October; same-day registration is not available. Start times are 11:10, 11:25 and 11:35. Start and finish are on the AV NOVA athletics track.

name: Bosloop Malden
description: The Bosloop Malden is a running race with a rich history dating back to 1978, held on Sunday, November 1, 2026. It is a popular event among the smaller running races in the Netherlands, ideal for testing your form two weeks before the Zevenheuvelenloop. The race offers 5, 10 and 15 km routes through the woods, as well as special races for young runners, including the Bambinoloop for children aged 3 to 8 and a 2 km race for children aged 9 to 12. Participation is free for children up to 12 years old, made possible in part by sponsor Medical Training Malden. Registration is open from September 1 through October 30, 2026, and closes once the maximum number of participants per distance has been reached.
course_highlights: Run through the woods of Malden
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 km
Special youth distances: Bambinoloop and 2 km Kidsrun
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the event grounds. The Bambinoloop has two starts: first ages 3–5, then ages 6–8. There is no timekeeping for the Bambinoloop. The 2 km race is part of the Scholenbokaal of the MTM Kidsrun Bosloop Malden. Registration on race day is not possible. Places are limited for each distance. Distances include 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with special races for children; participation is free for children under 12; registration runs from September 1 to October 30, 2026; registration on race day is not possible.

name: Haarlerbergloop
distance_verbose: 30 km, Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
price_range: € 2 voor herinneringsmedaille, overige kosten niet gespecificeerd
description: The Haarlerbergloop is a challenging running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Sallandse Heuvelrug, with almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland. The event takes place over two days: the Haarlerbergtrail, with distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 km, is on Saturday 31 October 2026, while the shorter distances of 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 km take place on Sunday 1 November 2026. The event is small-scale and is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and the CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, where facilities including toilets and a changing area are available.
course_highlights: Almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland
Beautiful routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Steep hills and wide-open views
additional: The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, with toilets and a changing area but no showers. Collecting your race number and leaving your bag are at your own risk. On-the-day registration is not available; advance registration is open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants in the 5 and 10 km races can buy a commemorative medal after the race (€ 2). The trail is limited to 349 participants, and registration closes no later than 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if full. Bringing your own drinking cup is mandatory for the trail; a reusable cup is available to buy (€ 4). There is no prize-giving for the trail, but every participant receives a medal. The 5 and 10 km races donate € 1 per participant to Stichting Support for Nature. Distances: 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 11 km, 16 km, 22 km and 30 km; cross-country event; registration opens in September; contribution to Support for Nature; races include the trail and youth distances.

name: Loop Esch Door
description: Loop Esch Door is a running event in and around the centre of Tubbergen, featuring a challenging, fast course across the Tubbergse Esch. Since 2022, the event has grown into an established race with a welcoming atmosphere and a great mix of competition and recreation. It offers various distances for runners of all levels, including special runs for children and people with disabilities. The start and finish are at Raadhuisplein in Tubbergen, where a friendly, community spirit is also central.
course_highlights: Fast course through the countryside and across the Tubbergse Esch
Start and finish at Raadhuisplein in the centre of Tubbergen
Various distances from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including walking routes
additional: Collect race numbers on 1 November from 08:00 at Tubbergen Town Hall, up to 30 minutes before the start. Walkers can collect their race numbers from 09:00. Parking at the swimming pool on Sportlaan is recommended. There is a water station on the course, and sports nutrition is available after the event. First aid is available along the course. KinderKroon KidsRuns start from 12:45, with different age categories. Prize-giving ceremonies take place shortly after each distance finishes. The event also offers an inclusive run for people with disabilities and has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Maasduinenloop
location: Afferden, Nationaal Park De Maasduinen, Limburg, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld per deelnemer bij voorinschrijving is € 4,00

description: The Maasduinenloop is an atmospheric running event held in De Maasduinen National Park, starting and finishing at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek in Afferden. The run offers a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings and combines sport with a friendly atmosphere. All proceeds go to burn care at the Expertise Centre for Child Trauma and Burn Care at Radboudumc Amalia Children’s Hospital. The Maasduinenloop welcomes runners of all ages and abilities, with a special focus on young participants through the Kidsrun.
course_highlights: Run through De Maasduinen National Park
Start and finish at atmospheric Golfbaan Bleijenbeek
New routes, including a 10 km loop
additional: Kidsrun start times: 10:30 (up to and including age 7, 500 m) and 10:45 (ages 8 to 11, 1,000 m). All Kidsrun participants receive a medal and a healthy snack. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the Kidsrun, at approximately 11:00. Teams may be all-male, all-female or mixed; the score is the combined time of the three fastest runners. Team members are automatically entered in the individual race at no extra cost. Start and finish at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 km. The course is marked and supervised by traffic marshals and mountain bikers, and timing is provided. Start and finish at Landgoed Bleijenbeek.

name: Warnsborncross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Warnsborncross kost 9 euro (alle afstanden)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Kidsrun kost 3 euro

description: The Warnsborncross is a traditional cross-country race held on the beautiful Warnsborn estate near Arnhem. The race follows unpaved paths past streams and ponds, with challenging elevation changes. There are three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 16.5 km, covering 1, 2 or 3 laps of 5.5 km respectively. There is also a 1,200-metre Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old. The start and race-number pickup take place at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through the Warnsborn estate
Running alongside streams and ponds
Challenging elevation changes
additional: Race-number pickup is available from 9:30 until 10:45 at the latest at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen, Kemperbergerweg 671a, 6816 RT Arnhem. The Kidsrun starts at 10:30, and the other distances start at 11:00. Start and registration at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen; the course follows unpaved paths with elevation changes and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit
description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit starts on 1 November 2026 and consists of nine varied running events spread over six months in the Groene Hart. The circuit is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers a platform where taking part matters more than winning. Participants can choose from different distances and benefit from a discounted circuit entry, including a free running shirt and a finisher’s gift for taking part in 8 or 9 events. The circuit encourages participation and promises a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nine varied runs in the Groene Hart
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and half marathon
Route along the picturesque Kromme Mijdrecht river and through Wickelhofpark
additional: Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like at the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate entry. There is a 10 km walk, a Family Run and a G-Run for children up to 12 years old. Lost race numbers can be replaced at the information desk. Changing rooms and showers are available, as is limited bag storage. Coffee, tea and soft drinks are available for collection in the sports hall. The prize-giving takes place in the sports hall. Nine varied runs between November 2026 and April 2027, including short, middle and long distances and a half marathon, with extra rewards for taking part in multiple events.

name: LPR - Last Pirate Running
description: LPR - Last Pirate Running is a running event taking place in Volendam on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The race offers a short distance of 1.6 kilometers, ideal for a fast and challenging running experience. Registration closes on October 20, 2026, and participants can sign up via the specified registration website. The event is organized by ProRun and is suitable for runners looking for a unique and accessible race.
course_highlights: Short distance of 1.6 km
Organized in picturesque Volendam
Fast and challenging course
additional: Registration for the 1.6 km distance closes on October 20, 2026. A training plan for 10 English miles (16.1 km) is available on the website and may help with preparation. Registration for the race was closed as of October 2026; the event is intended for runners who want to enjoy a short and fun race in North Holland.

name: Kievit Sport Twentsche Cross Competitie
organizer: AV Goor, AV Iphitos, ASV Eibergen, AAV Sisu, AC Tion, LAAC Twente
description: The Kievit Sport Twentse Cross Competition is a challenging cross-country series comprising six races in Twente’s beautiful natural areas. The competition offers a unique opportunity to test yourself against peers and enjoy the region’s winter conditions. The races vary in distance and are open to different age categories, from youth to masters. With strong local involvement and sponsors such as Kievit Sport and Wiggers Vleeswaren, this competition is a much-loved event among runners in Twente.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country courses in various natural areas of Twente
Distances range from 1 km for youth to 10 km for seniors and masters
A unique collaboration between six athletics clubs in the region
additional: Race numbers can be collected at locations such as Zwembad de Vijf Heuvels (Markelo). Changing rooms and toilets are available. For age categories, the reference date is the participant’s age at the final race for youth and at the first race for masters. The competition is made possible in part by local sponsors and six athletics clubs. A 2.5/5 km Canicross distance is also held during the Hulsbeekcross. The competition includes races such as Hessenheemcross, Wintercross, Oudejaarscross, Rutbeekcross, Hulsbeekcross and Dinkelcross, with results and standings available on the official website.

name: Maple Leaf Wintercup
organizer: GAC Hilversum en de Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: prijzen stijgen vanaf 15 augustus, doe nu nog mee met de early-bird prijzen!

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Maple Leaf Wintercup 2026, held on Sunday, November 1 at Bosbad De Vuursche in Baarn, is an atmospheric running and walking event set against a beautiful autumn backdrop. The race is organized by Gooise Atletiek Club Hilversum and Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging and offers challenging unpaved courses surrounded by autumn colors. There are various distances for both walkers and runners, including youth distances and recreational runs with and without a competition licence. The start and finish are on the atmospheric grounds around Bosbad De Vuursche, creating a fun and sporty atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging unpaved course amid autumn colors
Long Cross of 9.5 km with 4 laps
Short Cross of 3.1 km with 2 laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected from October 25 through 31 at Run2Day Hilversum or on race day at race headquarters. There is no separate gender categorization for the Short and Long Cross. Pupils of the organizing athletics clubs can participate free of charge after registering via the contact form. There is a recreational run and a competition-licence run for the short and long cross. The courses consist of multiple laps depending on the distance. The course includes unpaved paths, with events such as Nordic walking, cross-country running and youth races; start and finish at Bosbad De Vuursche.

name: Spaarnwoudecross
description: The Mokums Cross Circuit is a series of four woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area, including the Spaarnwoude Cross, organized by Haarlem Atletiek in Spaarndam. Participants register for at least three of these races and have a chance to receive a fun memento. There is a standings competition for the main events, with each runner’s best three results from the four races counting. The circuit is made possible through a partnership between five Amsterdam athletics clubs and their sponsor.
course_highlights: Woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area
Four different locations: Spaarndam, Amsterdamse Bos, De Eenhoorn, Gaasperplas
A memento for participants in at least three races
additional: Participants in at least three races receive a memento. The 20 fastest men and women in the main events score points toward the overall standings. The prize-giving takes place at the first race of the season. A muddy cross-country race and family and youth event, held on 2 November 2025 in Haarlem at Wheelerplanet in Spaarndam, with participants such as Tessa Weening and Sophie Kwak.

name: Hermans Assurantiën Duatlon
description: The Hermans Assurantiën Duathlon, organised by AVR'69, is a well-known off-road run-mountain bike-run event held in the beautiful forests of Reusel. The 25th edition takes place on Sunday, 1 November 2026, and offers both competitive distances (14 km running, 60 km mountain biking, 7 km running) for athletes aged 18 and over, and recreational distances (7 km running, 30 km mountain biking, 3.5 km running) for participants aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at sports park D'n Hoek, which also has ample changing and shower facilities. Participants can register individually or as a team, and a hot meal is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Run-mountain bike-run event in the forests of Reusel
Off-road course; mountain bikes are required
Start and finish at sports park D'n Hoek, with good facilities
additional: All events start together at 10:00. Participants must use a mountain bike. A hot meal is provided after the race for competitive athletes. Parking is available at the sports park D'n Hoek car park, but cars are not allowed inside the sports park. There are ample shower and changing facilities in the AVR'69 clubhouse. Cash prizes and medals are awarded in the competitive and recreational categories. You can register individually or as a team (a running and cycling duo). The race takes place on 1 November 2026, and registration is open from 10 April 2026 to 31 October 2026. The race starts at 10:00 and requires a mountain bike. Participants must be at least 18 years old for the main race and 16 for the recreational event.

location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Oirschot, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Van de Meerendonk Heath Trail is a beautiful recreational event across the expansive Oirschot heathland, suitable for runners and walkers. The routes are clearly marked with arrows, making it impossible to get lost. Water and fruit stations are available on all distances, and afterwards you can enjoy a friendly atmosphere with free coffee or tea and a treat. The event starts at Gilde Sint Sebastiaan in Oirschot, with several distances available for both running and walking.
course_highlights: Expansive woodland and heathland
Routes clearly marked with arrows
Water and fruit stations on all distances
additional: Start location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Wintelresedijk 1, 5688GW Oirschot. Runners start between 8:30 and 9:30, walkers between 9:00 and 9:30. Toilet and changing facilities are limited; there are no showers. Free coffee or tea and a treat are available after the event until 13:00. Members of Atletiek Oirschot pay €5,00 for all distances when registering in advance. Registration and payment on the day are possible but discouraged. Routes are marked with arrows; water and fruit stations are available on all distances. Start time is between 8.30 and 9.30. There are no prizes. Free coffee and tea are provided after the event. Participation is at your own risk. Facilities are limited, with no showers.

name: Leesten Cross
description: The Leestencross is a recreational cross-country race held in the beautiful woodland around Ugchelen. The race offers a challenging course along forest, sand and heathland paths, with no muddy sections, and rewards you with a magnificent view over the heath. It’s an ideal opportunity to test your fitness and race performance in a welcoming and accessible setting. The start and finish are at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten, a top destination for runners in the Netherlands.
course_highlights: Course along forest, sand and heathland paths
Magnificent view over the heath
Start and finish at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten in Ugchelen
additional: After handing in your race number, you will receive a voucher for a refreshment. No changing facilities are available. First aid is available. The 10 km race counts toward AV Veluwe’s cross-country club championship. Trail run on sand paths in Kroondomein, approximately 60 metres of elevation gain, registration closed, start/finish location: Wildrooster Wenum-Wiesel, no showers or changing facilities, first aid available.

name: Twentse Smokkel Trail
description: The Twentse Smokkel Trail is a unique trail run in the border region of Losser, taking place on 1 November 2026. The routes are 90% unpaved and cross varied terrain with many singletracks, taking participants to places where running is normally not allowed. There are several distances, from challenging 27 km and 22 km runs to a 10 km Drop Off Trail, where participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. In addition to the trail runs, there is a walking trail and a kids’ trail. Participants symbolically smuggle a packet of butter across the border and receive a Twentse krentenwegge after the finish as a reward.
course_highlights: 90% unpaved paths with many singletracks
The route passes through unspoilt forests and nature ponds, and along the Dinkel
A unique border crossing with symbolic butter smuggling and musical support along the way
additional: Refreshment stations are located at approximately 11 km and 4 km before the finish, plus a water station 2 km before the finish. The start and finish are at the Multifunctionele Accommodatie, Nilantspad 3 in Losser, where changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. The 10 km Drop Off Trail starts at the German monastery in Bardel; participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. Timing is provided for the 27, 22 and 14 km trails, but not for the 10 km Drop Off Trail. Dogs are not allowed. After the finish, participants receive a wooden medal and a Twentse krentenwegge. The three fastest men and women in each distance are presented with a handmade smuggling trophy. Trail and walking routes on unpaved paths, including a kids’ trail and a drop-off trail, with a theme of smuggling history and experiencing nature. Registration opens on 1 July 2026 via inschrijven.nl, with participant limits for each distance and refreshment stations at 11 and 23 km.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠE LIGA Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race taking place on October 28, 2026, in Prague 4-Braník. The course follows the cycle path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back. It is flat and fast, often allowing runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a pleasant half-marathon in beautiful surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00 on the cycle path by Kempink 2.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the cycle path along the Vltava
The course runs from Braník to Vrané and back
Beautiful surroundings and the chance to achieve a personal best
additional: The race starts on the cycle path by Kempink 2 in Prague 4-Braník. The race is organized by VAŠE LIGA; the contact person is Petr Lundák. The course is flat and fast, making it suitable for personal bests. A relaxed running atmosphere is guaranteed. The course is measured by a certified course measurer, and the race uses chip timing. It includes refreshments, a medal, a certificate, a shower, toilets, changing facilities, and the option to withdraw up to 24 hours before the start.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children. Adults run 3.2 km through the town, mostly on asphalt, while children take a shorter route with off-road obstacles. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place in a friendly atmosphere, with no times or rankings recorded.
course_highlights: Adults run 3.2 km on paved paths and asphalt through the town
Children’s 350 m course features several off-road obstacles near the Sokol hall
Adults run their loop twice; the route passes the polyclinic and housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Sports activity stations are set up for children at the event grounds. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the Sokol hall car park. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event is held every year on October 28 and is open to participants from different continents, with online registration available and a race pack that includes a medal. The route passes through town streets, by the polyclinic and the Sokol hall, with parking available nearby.

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov in the Zlín Region. The race offers three distances—5, 11 and 21 km—which run mainly along field and forest paths. Shorter age-based courses with free entry are available for children. The event is suitable for the general public and takes place whatever the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play.

Three distances of varying difficulty: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km
Children’s courses by age group with free entry

Entry is free for preschool children and pupils taking part in the children’s races. Each participant runs at their own risk. The organiser reserves the right to make changes or cancel the race in extreme conditions without compensation. Outdoor course; registration online or on site; compliance with road traffic rules and wearing a race number are mandatory. description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no racing, held on 28 October in the picturesque Oslava and Chvojnice valley. The routes follow paved and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs, ideal for anyone who wants to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia by getting active. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.

The run takes place in the Oslava and Chvojnice Valley Nature Reserve
Two main adult routes: 5 km and 6.2 km, with a challenge from ambassador Katarína Pejpková
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no ranked results list is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adult and 30 child participants. Toilets are available, course marshals staff the route, a race pack is provided at the event facilities, and a medal shaped like the republic is awarded at the finish. Non-competitive run, routes from 0.6 km to 6.2 km, capacity of 20 for the main race and 30 child participants, accompanying programme, free refreshments, online registration, facilities on private grounds, on the border of the Divoká Oslava reserve

description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on October 28, offering routes for adults and children. The main race is 5 km long and runs through the picturesque city, through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the Elbe Embankment. Children’s races are offered in two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, who run along the river and Mariánská louka. The course is flat, with varied sections, and professionally timed. At the finish, participants receive a medal shaped like the republic. The event celebrates the republic and offers a sporting atmosphere for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km route through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Run along the Elbe Embankment and across Tyrš Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. At the finish, each participant receives a race pack with a race number and gifts from partners. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits at the finish. The route is suitable for all age groups, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The race includes professional timing, medals, and race packs; routes pass through city landmarks and natural scenery; the event caters to various age groups with different race lengths.

description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 8.9 km long and runs partly alongside the Desná stream, across fields and along the edge of the village, combining paved roads with surfaced forest and field paths. Children can choose a 1.4 km course on paved roads and through the housing estate. Facilities at the Sokol hall include a race pack, refreshments, changing rooms and parking. Everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.

The route follows the Desná stream for part of the way and crosses the surrounding fields
The 1.4 km children’s courses run on paved roads and through the housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race bib and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol hall include changing rooms, refreshments and parking. Timing may be manual or chip-timed, but is not compulsory. Suitable for children and adults. The event takes place in Dolní Újezd, Pardubice Region, on October 28, with online registration available and facilities offering refreshments and parking.

The race offers a sporting atmosphere and a family-friendly experience in the beautiful surroundings of a city with a rich sporting tradition. The main course is just under six kilometres long, with the start and finish at the Sokol hall, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Safe courses for children are set up on the Sokol hall grounds. Capacity is limited to approximately 155 runners to ensure high-quality organisation and timekeeping.

Main course of just under 6 km through the city
Safe children’s courses on the Sokol hall grounds, with no need to cross roads

The event is organised by a team of 4–5 people, with support from volunteers. The children’s courses are safely located on the Sokol hall grounds. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers various courses, including children’s courses, with online registration and an accompanying programme in Oleška, Central Bohemian Region.

description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 5.6 km long and passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and offers a race pack, a medal shaped like the republic, and a raffle for participants in the main race. The start and finish are in the square in front of the château in Louňovice pod Blaníkem. In addition to the main race, children’s courses of 0.4, 0.8, and 1.3 km are available.

Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths
additional: All races are electronically timed. After the race, participants in the main race can enter a raffle. Everyone will receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Each participant can collect their race pack at the race facilities. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series. An accompanying program and refreshments are provided. The races are electronically timed, free parking is available in the square, and proceeds support charitable projects.

description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race is run without mandatory timekeeping; participants receive a starter pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. The main race course is 7.3 km long and runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard, past the railway line and Lužák Pond. Shorter children’s courses of 0.2, 0.5 and 1 km are laid on paved surfaces. The race facilities are at the Sokol Hall complex, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and refreshments available.

Children’s courses run on paved surfaces

Children can enjoy sports activities and games at the venue. Time may be recorded manually or with a timing system, but timekeeping is not mandatory. The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard. Children can run on paved surfaces. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is approximately 500 m from the complex.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers a 5 km adult course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka, with the start and finish by the state château. Shorter children’s loops are set on a grassy area and are easy, making them suitable for different age groups. Facilities at the start include registration, changing tents, toilets and refreshments, and parking is free. Every participant receives a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.

Children’s loops on a grassy area, with distances of 150 m, 500 m and 1 km
Start and finish by Mníšek pod Brdy State Château

At the start, there is a registration tent, changing tents, toilets, refreshments and benches. Free parking is available right by the start. The course is asphalt for up to 1 km; the children’s courses are on grass. The start is by the state château, with registration and refreshments on site. Parking is free. The event has no official timekeeper, but all participants receive a medal.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov

description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a 4.8 km course for adults, running from the town along country roads through the village of Humburky and crossing the Cidlina River via two bridges. Shorter 250 m and 420 m races for children take place at the Sportring complex. The race is held in open traffic, with marshals at intersections, and offers a race pack and a republic-shaped medal for all participants.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course with 30% asphalt and 70% country roads
Crossing the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race is held in open traffic, with marshals and volunteers at intersections. A cyclist will lead the front runner. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. In bad weather, race-pack collection is in the Sokol hall lobby; in normal conditions, it is outside by the clay court. The awards ceremony for the children’s races will take place shortly after they finish. The 4.8 km route is mostly on country roads. Online registration, refreshments at the finish, parking by the Sokol hall or Penny Market, start at Revoluční třída 774.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Sokolský stadion, Uherský Brod, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The 5 km main race starts at the Sokol stadium and runs through the city centre, through residential areas and on to a garden colony, past a pond and back to the stadium. Shorter courses of 0.17 km, 0.34 km and 0.8 km are available for children and run around the stadium and nearby park. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. On-site registration is available. Participants under 18 may take part only with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The 5 km main course runs through the city centre and residential areas
Past a garden colony and a pond
Children’s courses run around the Sokol stadium and nearby park

Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available at the Sokol stadium, and refreshments are available at the start. Free parking is available in the adjacent car park and around the Sokol hall. No accompanying programme is provided. Courses include 5 km for adults and 170 m, 340 m and 800 m for children; online registration is open until 24 October 2025; the event takes place in Uherský Brod; toilets, showers, changing rooms, refreshments and free parking are available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. This run has become a modern tradition that is growing in many places across the Czech Republic and abroad. Participants can choose from various routes for adults and children, which run on both paved roads and forest trails. The event is open to all runners who want to celebrate the founding of the republic through exercise and the joy of running.

The course runs on both paved roads and unpaved forest trails
The finish is always at the Sokol hall, where a beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits

name: BĚHÁMOS - rodinné běžecké závody
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃 BĚHÁMOS – family running races by Holasice Primary and Nursery School
On Sunday, October 4, from 10:00, we’ll get Holasice moving!
Register HERE:
https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8
BĚHÁMOS is a family running event that brings together what matters to us: children, adults, school, exercise and Holasice. And since we’re a school, our most famous teacher, Jan Amos Komenský, has to be part of it too. That’s where BĚH + ÁMOS = BĚHÁMOS comes from.
We don’t just want to organize a race to see who gets the best times. We want to create a day when children, parents, grandparents, friends and neighbors can all meet in one place. In short, a sports gathering with a family atmosphere.
📅 SUNDAY, 4 OCTOBER 2026
📍 Na Cihelně sports ground, Holasice
https://mapy.com/s/locojejatu
⏱️ Races start from 10:00
📝 Race check-in: 9:00–9:30
🏅 CATEGORIES
AMOS’S LITTLE SPROUTS
born 2021–2023 | 200 m
AMOS’S LITTLE RUNNERS
born 2019–2020 | 250 m
AMOS’S SPEEDSTERS
born 2017–2018 | 500 m

born 2015–2016 | 750 m

born 2013–2014 | 1,400 m

BĚHÁMOS RUNNERS

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 AMOS’S FAMILY RELAY

To finish, we’ll join forces in Amos’s family relay. And “family” doesn’t mean you have to show a birth certificate when you register. 😊
Each four-person team simply consists of two adults and two children. Parents can run with their children, a mom with an uncle, two dads, two moms, or even two families who are friends. You don’t have to be related—the important thing is to put together a team of 2 + 2 and BĚHÁMOS!

Medals and prizes will be provided for runners. Refreshments, facilities and portable toilets will also be available.
Above all, though, we want to enjoy a pleasant morning of sport where the most important thing isn’t who finishes first, but that we BĚHÁMOS together.
⚠️ PARTICIPATION AND RESPONSIBILITY
Each runner takes part in the race voluntarily and at their own responsibility and risk. By registering, they confirm that they are medically fit to complete the chosen course. The legal guardian is responsible for the health and safety of any underage runner.
Runners must follow the organizers’ instructions and behave in a way that does not endanger themselves or other participants.

name: II Bieg Transgranicznej Przyjaźni
description:
A 5-kilometre main race, a Nordic walking event over the same distance, and shorter races for children in the Young Athlete Zone. The event opens the Polish-Czech Grand Prix series, which concludes a month later in Ludgeřovice.

Course: moderately easy, with a new route this year

We have changed the route compared with the first edition. Four kilometres now run along Teligi and Czarnieckiego streets—on asphalt, with plenty of space and no tight turns. It’s a stretch where you can keep a steady pace from start to finish.

Only the final kilometre goes through post-mining areas. The surface gets uneven, but it’s just five minutes of running—and also the most interesting part of the course. You run through a part of Silesia that is coming back to life.

The total elevation gain is 18 metres, spread across the whole distance. There are no climbs that disrupt your rhythm. It’s a good course for your first-ever five kilometres, and a fair one for anyone looking to test their time—as long as you save some strength for the finish.
additional:
The event is part of the “Pink October” campaign and promotes breast cancer prevention. It is organised by the “Srebrne Nici” Association, with the Czech club BK Ludgeřovice as its partner.

Photos from the previous edition.

name: Bieg Wolności Podatkowej
description:
When the tax authorities let up, the race begins! IFIRMA invites you to a special event celebrating Tax Freedom Day and the company’s 25th anniversary. It’s a race for entrepreneurs, IFIRMA customers, and everyone who values being active, independence, and good energy.

On June 13, participants can take on the 5 km or 10 km distance, either in person in Wrocław or virtually from anywhere in Poland. The main event will take place at the Olympic Stadium, and the route follows a scenic loop along the Oder. Flat and scenic—ideal running conditions in the City of a Hundred Bridges.

Every step has extra meaning here. Race participants support the “Na Ratunek Dzieciom z Chorobą Nowotworową” Foundation, showing that the energy of sport can make a real difference to others. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with supporting an important cause.

Participants will also receive a generous race pack prepared by IFIRMA: the official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, a race bib, a reusable cup, a sports bag, and a certificate for a tree of their own in the IFIRMA forest in Oleśnica.

Join the 2026 Tax Freedom Run and celebrate freedom actively!
